records.jp: 〇日菜子の人となり^00星ノ宮女子高等学校普通科に通う少女。高校一年生。^00かつて天才バレリーナとして将来を嘱望されていた^00ものの、怪我によって引退を余儀なくされた。^00バレエという生きがいを失った日菜子は登校することも^00できず、空っぽの日々を送っていた。
records.en_original: About Hinako^00A first-year student enrolled in the regular class at Hoshinomiya Girls' High School. Though she was once a promising ballet prodigy, she was forced to retire due to an injury. After losing ballet, her greatest passion, Hinako became unable to attend school and spent her days feeling empty.
records.en: About Hinako A first-year^00student enrolled in the regular class at Hoshinomiya Girls'^00High School. Though she was once a promising ballet prodigy,^00she was forced to retire due to an injury. After^00losing ballet, her greatest passion, Hinako became unable to attend^00school and spent her days feeling empty.

records.jp: 〇日菜子の願い^00不思議な指輪を身に着けた日菜子は、^00当初、リフレクターとしての自分に戸惑っていた。^00しかし、すべての原種を倒せば一つだけ願いが叶う^00という話を聞き、彼女は戦いへ身を投じ始める。^00彼女の願いは、ひとえに、^00「もう一度バレエを踊りたい」というものであった。
records.en_original: Hinako's Wish^00After putting on the mysterious ring, Hinako was initially confused about her new life as a Reflector. However, when she heard that defeating all the Sephira would grant her a single wish, she resolved to step into battle. Her wish was simple: to be able to dance ballet again.
records.en: Hinako's Wish^00After putting on the mysterious ring,^00Hinako was initially confused about her new life as^00a Reflector. However, when she heard that defeating^00all the Sephira would grant her a single wish, she^00resolved to step into battle.^00Her wish was simple: to be able to dance ballet again.

records.jp: 〇日菜子の決意と最後の戦い^00すべての原種を倒しても願いは叶わないどころか、^00夕月と来夢は世界からも人々の記憶からも消える。^00真実を前にしてもなお、日菜子は戦い抜く覚悟を固めた。^00友人たちの言葉に励まされながら、^00彼女は最後の戦いに挑む。
records.en_original: Hinako's Resolve and the Final Battle^00Even if all the Sephira are defeated, her wish will not come true—in fact, Yuzu and Lime will vanish from both the world and people's memories. Despite being faced with this truth, Hinako strengthened her resolve to fight. Encouraged by the words of her friends, she prepares to take on the final battle.
records.en: Hinako's Resolve and the Final Battle^00Even if all the Sephira are defeated, her wish will not come true—in fact,^00Yuzu and Lime will vanish from both the world and people's memories.^00Despite being faced with this truth, Hinako strengthened her resolve to fight.^00Encouraged by the words of her friends, she^00prepares to take on the final battle.

records.jp: 〇ダアト打倒後の黄昏^00ダアトすら撥ね返し、すべての原種に勝利した日菜子は、^00夕暮れのグラウンドで、^00夕月と来夢の２人と共に、最後のひとときを過ごす。^00やがて訪れた別れの瞬間、^00彼女は「二人を絶対に忘れない」と強く願ったのだった。
records.en_original: Twilight After Daath's Defeat^00Having repelled even Daath and defeated all the Sephira, Hinako spends her final moments on the sports field at dusk together with Yuzu and Lime. When the time for their farewell finally comes, she desperately wishes to never forget about the two of them.
records.en: Twilight After Daath's Defeat^00Having repelled even Daath and defeated all the Sephira, Hinako^00spends her final moments^00on the sports field at dusk together with Yuzu and Lime. When the time^00for their farewell finally^00comes, she desperately wishes to never forget about the two of them.

records.jp: 〇日菜子の本当の願い^00日差しの強い夏の日。^00由来知れずの指輪をお守りに、日菜子は校門をくぐる。^00その時ふと、「ヒナちゃん」と呼ぶ声が脳裏をよぎった。^00絶対に忘れないと願った、大切な２人のことを、^00彼女は確かに覚えていた。
records.en_original: Hinako's True Wish^00On a bright, sunny summer day, Hinako stepped through the school gates, clutching a mysterious ring as her good luck charm. Suddenly, voices calling "Hina" echoed in her mind. She remembered those two precious people she had wished to never forget—without a doubt, they were still in her heart.
records.en: Hinako's True Wish On a bright,^00sunny summer day, Hinako^00stepped through the school gates, clutching a mysterious ring as her good luck^00charm. Suddenly, voices calling "Hina-chan" echoed in her mind. She remembered^00those two precious people she had wished to never forget—without^00a doubt, they were still in her heart.

records.jp: 〇夕月の人となり^00日菜子の前に現れた不思議な少女。司城来夢の姉。^00明るく、誰からも好かれる性格で、^00日菜子に対しても親しく接する。^00愛称はユズ。
records.en_original: About Yuzuki^00A mysterious girl who appeared before Hinako. She is the older sister of Lime Shijou. Bright and well-liked by everyone, she is friendly with Hinako as well. Her nickname is Yuzu.
records.en: About Yuzuki A mysterious^00girl who appeared before Hinako. She is the older sister of Shijou^00Lime. Bright and well-liked by everyone,^00she is friendly with Hinako as well. Her^00nickname is Yuzu.

records.jp: 〇リフレクターの先輩^00日菜子にリフレクターの力を与えた張本人。^00妹と同じく、夕月自身もリフレクターである。^00日菜子にリフレクターの役割や戦い方を教えた。
records.en_original: Senior Reflector^00Yuzuki is responsible for Hinako being granted Reflector powers. She and her younger sister, Lime, are also Reflectors themselves. They taught Hinako about the duties of a Reflector and how to fight.
records.en: Senior Reflector Yuzuki is responsible^00for Hinako being granted Reflector powers. She^00and her younger sister, Lime, are also Reflectors themselves.^00They taught Hinako about the duties of a Reflector and how to fight.

records.jp: 〇夕月の死亡事故と生前の憧れ^00コモンと現実世界を接続する実験での事故により、^00来夢と共に、夕月は命を落としていた。^00度重なる実験の合間に見た日菜子のバレエに心奪われ、^00彼女のファンになったのだった。^00^00
records.en_original: Yuzuki's Fatal Accident and Admiration While Alive^00Due to an accident during an experiment connecting the Common with the real world, Yuzu and Lime both lost their lives. In between repeated experiments before the accident, she was captivated by Hinako's ballet and became her fan.
records.en: Yuzuki's Fatal Accident and Admiration^00While Alive Due to an accident during an experiment connecting the Common^00with the real world, Yuzu and Lime both lost their^00lives. records.jp: 〇来夢の人となり^00日菜子の前に現れた不思議な少女。司城夕月の妹。^00効率主義者的な一面があり、他人の心情よりも^00計画の進行や自分の気持ちを大切にする時がある。^00ただし、日菜子を大切に想っている点は姉と変わりない。^00愛称はライム。
records.en_original: About Lime^00A mysterious girl who appeared before Hinako. She is the younger sister of Yuzuki Shijou. Lime has a pragmatic side and sometimes values her own plans and feelings over the emotions of others. However, like her sister, she cares deeply for Hinako.
records.en: About Lime A mysterious^00girl who appeared before Hinako. She is the younger^00sister of Shijou Yuzuki. Lime has a pragmatic side^00and sometimes values her own plans and feelings over^00the emotions of others. However, like her sister, she cares^00deeply for Hinako.

records.jp: 〇更紗の人となり^00中学時代、日菜子をライバル視していたバレリーナ。^00天才型であり、バレエのみならず様々な踊りに通じる。^00日菜子の引退理由を知らなかったため、彼女に対して^00キツい態度を取っているが、本来は人当たりの良い性格。
records.en_original: About Sarasa^00A ballerina who saw Hinako as her rival back in middle school. She is a prodigy, skilled not only in ballet but also in many other forms of dance. Since she didn't know the reason behind Hinako's retirement, she tended to act harshly toward her, but she usually gets along well with others.
records.en: About Sarasa A ballerina^00who saw Hinako as her rival back in middle school. She is a prodigy,^00skilled not only in ballet but also in many other forms of dance.^00Since she didn't know the reason behind Hinako's retirement, she^00tended to act harshly toward her, but she usually gets along well with others.

records.jp: 〇日菜子への想い^00バレリーナとして日菜子をライバル視しながらも、^00彼女に対して非常に強い憧れを抱いている。^00日菜子の怪我の重さを知って以降、密かに治療法を^00調べ続けているほど、彼女のことを想っていた。
records.en_original: Feelings Toward Hinako^00Although she sees Hinako as a rival ballerina, she also deeply admires her. Ever since learning about the seriousness of Hinako's injury, she has secretly researched possible treatments out of strong concern for her.
records.en: Feelings Toward Hinako Although^00she sees Hinako as a rival ballerina, she also^00deeply admires her. Ever since learning about^00the seriousness of Hinako's injury, she has secretly researched^00possible treatments out of strong concern for her.

records.jp: 〇日菜子との新しい関係^00日菜子の気持ちを想像しきれない自分に気づいており、^00心優しい彼女はひとり、不安や苦しみを抱えていた。^00気持ちを通わせ合った後は、^00バレリーナとしても友達としても日菜子のことを^00信頼するようになり、時折踊りを見せる仲になった。
records.en_original: A New Relationship with Hinako^00After realizing that she couldn't fully understand Hinako's feelings, Sarasa's heart was weighed down by anxiety and pain. After the two communicated their feelings, she came to trust Hinako both as a ballerina and a friend, and began to show Hinako her dances on occasion.
records.en: A New Relationship with Hinako^00After realizing that she couldn't fully understand Hinako's^00feelings, Sarasa's heart was weighed down by anxiety and pain.^00After the two communicated^00their feelings, she came to trust Hinako both as a ballerina^00and a friend, and began to show Hinako her dances on occasion.

records.jp: 〇麻央の人となり^00子役のころから活躍している女優。^00全盛期ほどではないが芸能活動を続けており、^00学内学外を問わず有名人。^00リーダー的な役割には就いていないものの、^00人当たりが良く、いつもクラスの中心にいる。
records.en_original: About Mao^00An actress who has starred in roles since her childhood. Although she is no longer at her peak, she continues to work in the entertainment industry and is well-known both inside and outside of the school. While she doesn't hold a leadership position, her friendly demeanor always makes her the center of attention in class.
records.en: About Mao An actress^00who has starred in roles since her childhood. Although she^00is no longer at her peak, she continues to work in the entertainment industry^00and is well-known both inside^00and outside of the school. While she doesn't hold a leadership position,^00her friendly demeanor always makes her the center of attention in class.

records.jp: 〇麻央の本性^00両親から金儲けの道具として扱われ、世間や知人からも^00激しく非難された過去を持つ。この経験から人の善意を^00信用しておらず、悪意こそが人の本質だと考えている。^00悪意をコントロールし、自分の世界を守るため、麻央は^00ガス抜きと称して周囲に不和の種をばら撒いていた。
records.en_original: Mao's True Nature^00Having been treated as a tool for making money by her parents and harshly criticized by society and those around her, Mao has a painful past. Because of this, she doesn't trust in people's goodwill, believing that malice is the true nature of humanity. To control malice and protect her own world, Mao sows seeds of discord around her, claiming it's just to let off steam.
records.en: Mao's True Nature^00Having been treated as a tool for making money by her parents and harshly^00criticized by society and those around her, Mao has a painful past.^00Because of this, she doesn't trust in people's goodwill, believing that malice^00is the true nature of humanity. To control malice and protect her own world,^00Mao sows seeds of discord around her, claiming it's just to let off steam.

records.jp: 〇麻央と日菜子の共闘^00人間の善意を信じようとする日菜子と折り合えず、^00麻央は彼女のことを拒絶し続けていた。^00しかし、原種の襲来に際し、自分の世界である学校を^00守りたいというその一点において日菜子と通じ合った。
records.en_original: Mao and Hinako's United Front^00Unable to agree with Hinako, who tries to believe in the goodwill of people, Mao continued to reject her. However, when the Sephira appeared, they found common ground in their shared desire to protect their world—the school.
records.en: Mao and Hinako's United^00Front Unable to agree with Hinako, who tries to believe^00in the goodwill of people, Mao continued to reject^00her. However, when the Sephira appeared, they found common^00ground in their shared desire to protect their world—the school.

records.jp: 〇圭の人となり^00頼りになる存在として慕われる、姉御肌の少女。^00悩んでいる人を放っておけないおせっかい気質だが、^00どこか天然じみた一面も持ち合わせており、^00妙なところで失敗することもしばしばある。
records.en_original: About Kei^00A dependable and big-hearted girl who is adored by those around her. She can't bring herself to ignore people in trouble, always lending a helping hand, though she sometimes gets carried away and ends up making strange mistakes.
records.en: About Kei A dependable^00and big-hearted girl who is adored by those around her.^00She can't bring herself to ignore people in trouble, always^00lending a helping hand, though she sometimes gets^00carried away and ends up making strange mistakes.

records.jp: 〇他人との距離感^00長らく登校していなかった日菜子を気にかけ、^00積極的に声を掛けに行っていた。^00持ち前のおせっかい気質で距離を詰めようとした結果、^00かえって日菜子を怒らせてしまう。^00とはいえ、圭の行動は１００％善意からのものであり、^00そこに悪意はまったくない。
records.en_original: Relationship with Others^00Kei was concerned about Hinako, who hadn't come to school for a long time, and actively reached out to her. However, she came off as overbearing and ended up making Hinako angry instead. Even so, Kei's actions were entirely motivated by good intentions, with absolutely no ill will.
records.en: Relationship with Others Kei^00was concerned about Hinako, who hadn't^00come to school for a long time, and actively^00reached out to her. However, she came off as overbearing^00and ended up making Hinako angry instead.^00Even so, Kei's actions were entirely motivated by good intentions,^00with absolutely no ill will.

records.jp: 〇勝負への密かなこだわり^00勝負ごとにおいては正々堂々戦うというこだわりがある。^00部活の方針を巡り先輩と対決することになった時、^00相手が卑劣な妨害を工作していたことを知り、^00圭は激しい怒りと悔しさを抱えてしまう。^00ただし、一件が解決した後には再び先輩と交流し始めた。^00根っこのところではやはり明るい少女。
records.en_original: A Secret Obsession with Competition^00Kei is dedicated to fighting fair in any competition. After facing off against some upperclassmen over her attitude during club, she learned that her opponents had resorted to underhanded interference and was overcome with intense anger and frustration. However, after the incident was resolved, she resumed interacting with those upperclassmen once again. At her core, she remains a cheerful girl.

records.jp: 〇有理の人となり^00生まれつき非常に高い知能を持つ少女。^00表向きは普通の生徒のフリをしているが、他人の感情を^00読み取ることが苦手。自分の感情も上手く表現できない。^00星ノ宮で何かが起こっていることに勘付いており、^00特に夕月と来夢の存在に興味を抱いている。
records.en_original: About Yuri^00A girl born with exceptionally high intelligence. She pretends to be an ordinary student on the surface, but she struggles to read the emotions of others and has difficulty expressing her own feelings. She suspects that something is happening at Hoshinomiya, and is especially interested in Yuzu and Lime.

She suspects that something is happening at Hoshinomiya,^00and is especially interested in Yuzu and Lime.

records.jp: 〇才能とその代償^00若くして科学雑誌に論文が掲載されるほどの天才だが、^00その一方で一般常識についてはかなり疎い。^00コンビニで買い物をしたことすらなく、商品を会計前に^00食べてしまったり、試着室の存在を知らなかったり、と、^00日常生活全般においてかなり抜けている。
records.en_original: Genius and Its Price^00Yuri is a prodigy who has had papers published in scientific journals at a young age, yet she is surprisingly clueless when it comes to common sense. Having never shopped at a convenience store before, she ate items before paying for them, and she was unaware of the existence of fitting rooms. In short, she's quite absent-minded about most aspects of everyday life.

In short, she's^00quite absent-minded about most aspects of everyday life.

records.jp: 〇人間への興味醸成^00数学や物理学をどれだけ究めてもヒトの心が理解できず^00悩んでいた有理は、日菜子と過ごす日々の中で、^00感情というものを次第に理解し始める。^00本当の意味で日菜子と友達になった彼女だったが、^00生活面でのポンコツ度合いは相変わらず。
records.en_original: Developing Interest in Humanity^00No matter how deeply she delved into mathematics and physics, Yuri struggled to understand the human heart. However, as she spent her days with Hinako, she gradually began to grasp the concept of emotions. She truly became Hinako's friend in every sense, but her everyday clumsiness hasn't changed a bit.

records.jp: 〇早苗の人となり^00日菜子と同じ中学校に通っていた少女。^00中学生の時は、クラスこそ違ったものの、^00有名なバレリーナである日菜子に対し憧れを抱いていた。^00日菜子が怪我でバレエを引退したことも知っており、^00彼女のことを密かに気にかけていた。^00高校では料理部に所属しており、腕前もそこそこ。
records.en_original: About Sanae^00A girl who attended the same junior high school as Hinako. Although they were in different classes in junior high, she admired Hinako, who was a famous ballerina. She also knows that Hinako retired from ballet due to an injury and has secretly worried about her. In high school, she is a fairly skilled member of the cooking club.

She^00also knows that Hinako retired from ballet due to an injury^00and has secretly worried about her. In high^00school, she is a fairly skilled member of the cooking club.

records.jp: 〇憧れの相手との接近^00たとえ今は引退していたとしても、早苗にとって^00日菜子が憧れの存在であることは変わらない。^00そんな相手と同じクラスで学校生活を送れるという^00事実に、彼女はフラグメントが暴走するほどの^00喜びを感じていた。
records.en_original: Getting Closer to Her Idol^00Even though Hinako has retired from ballet, she remains someone Sanae admires deeply. The mere fact that she could attend the same class and share school life with her idol filled Sanae with so much joy that her Fragment went rampant.
records.en: Getting Closer to Her Idol^00Even though Hinako has retired from ballet, she^00remains someone Sanae admires deeply. The mere fact that she^00could attend the same class and share school life^00with her idol filled Sanae with so much joy that her^00Fragment went rampant.

records.jp: 〇意外な趣味^00早苗にはラップバトルという意外な趣味がある。^00普段のおだやかな性格からは想像できないほど、^00彼女のラップへの想いとこだわりは強い。^00今日も、どこかで誰かにラップバトルを仕掛けている。
records.en_original: Unexpected Hobby^00Sanae has a rather surprising hobby: rap battles. Contrary to her usual gentle demeanor, her passion and commitment to rap are intense. Even now, she's probably out there challenging someone to a rap battle.
records.en: Unexpected Hobby Sanae has a rather^00surprising hobby: rap battles.^00Contrary to her usual gentle demeanor, her passion^00and commitment to rap are intense. Even now,^00she's probably out there challenging someone to a rap battle.

records.jp: 〇凛の人となり^00テニス部に所属している少女。実力はそこそこ。^00普段は優柔不断な性格をしているが、一度思い込んだら^00とことん一途になってしまう。^00中学時代の先輩に片思い中。
records.en_original: About Rin^00A decently skilled member of the tennis club. Normally, she can be quite indecisive, but once she sets her mind on something, she becomes completely devoted to it. She currently has a crush on an upperclassman from her middle school days.
records.en: About Rin^00A decently skilled member of the tennis club.^00Normally, she can be quite indecisive, but once she sets her mind on something,^00she becomes completely devoted to it.^00She currently has a crush on a senpai from her middle school days.

records.jp: 〇思春期の複雑な心^00片思いの先輩に告白したいとは思っているものの、^00どうやって想いを伝えるべきか決めきれないでいた。^00このままではずっと告白できないまま終わってしまうと^00分かっていながら、それでも決断できない^00自分の優柔不断さと心の弱さが悩み。
records.en_original: The Complex Heart of Adolescence^00Rin wanted to confess to the upperclassman she has a crush on, but couldn't decide how to express her feelings. Even though she knew that she would never be able to confess if things stayed like that, she still couldn't make up her mind, struggling with her own indecisiveness and lack of courage.
records.en: The Complex Heart of Adolescence^00Rin wanted to confess to the senpai she has a crush on,^00but couldn't decide how to express her feelings.^00She knew that if things stayed this way, she might never confess,^00yet she still couldn't make up her mind.^00She struggles with her own indecisiveness and lack of courage.

records.jp: 〇食事へのこだわり^00一日にジュースを数本飲んだり、間食に家からパンや^00おにぎりを持参したり、と、結構な食いしん坊。^00実は料理も得意で、その実力は料理部の早苗をも^00唸らせるほど。^00凛の料理への向上心は、ひとえに、好きな先輩に^00美味しいものを食べさせたいという想いからである。
records.en_original: Attentiveness to Food^00Rin is quite the foodie, often going through several bottled drinks a day and bringing bread or rice balls from home for snacks. She's actually good at cooking too, impressing even Sanae from the cooking club with her skills. Rin's drive to improve her cooking comes from a single wish: to serve delicious food to her crush.
records.en: Attentiveness to Food^00Rin is quite the foodie, often drinking several bottles of juice a day^00and bringing bread or onigiri from home for snacks.^00She's also an excellent cook,^00skilled enough to impress Sanae from the cooking club.^00Rin is always striving to improve her cooking, all for one wish:^00to make delicious food for the senpai she likes.

records.jp: 〇亜子の人となり^00お金に目がない少女。^00その行動から場を乱すこともしばしばあるのだが、^00どこか憎めない愛嬌がある。^00放送部に所属しており、学校の事件をネタにしている。^00日菜子のことを転校生と勘違いしていた。
records.en_original: About Ako^00Ako can't resist anything to do with money. Her actions sometimes cause trouble, but there's an undeniable charm about her that's hard to dislike. She's a member of the broadcasting club and often turns school incidents into stories for her broadcasts. She mistakenly thought that Hinako was a transfer student.
records.en: About Ako Ako can't resist anything to do with money.^00Her actions sometimes cause trouble, but there's^00an undeniable charm about her that's hard to dislike.^00She's a member of the broadcasting club and often turns^00school incidents into stories for her broadcasts.^00She mistakenly thought that Hinako was a transfer student.

records.jp: 〇将来の夢^00将来の夢はジャーナリスト。ゆくゆくは紛争地域にも^00飛び込んで取材したいと考えているが、^00大物ロック歌手の父親からは反対されている。^00「あこジャーナル」という、日菜子の正体を知っている^00生徒向けのニュースサイトを運営中。
records.en_original: Future Dreams^00Ako's dream is to become a journalist. Eventually, she wants to cover stories even in conflict zones, but her father, a famous rock singer, is against it. She currently run a news site called "Ako's Journal" for students who know Hinako's true identity.
records.en: Future Dreams^00Ako dreams of becoming a journalist.^00Eventually, she hopes to report from conflict zones,^00but her father, a big-name rock singer, is against it.^00She currently runs a news site called "Ako's Journal"^00for students who know Hinako's true identity.

records.jp: 〇お金より大切なもの^00動画配信でお金稼ぎを始めた亜子は、目標通り^00大金を手にしたものの、プライベートな時間が減り、^00友達をも間接的に傷つけてしまう。^00お金や自由時間の意味を見つめ直した彼女は、^00動画配信業を辞めることで元の生活を取り戻し、^00ジャーナリストという本来の夢に回帰していった。
records.en_original: Something More Precious than Money^00Ako started making money by streaming videos online and achieved her goal of earning a large sum. However, she found herself with less personal time and even ended up unintentionally hurting her friends. After reconsidering the true value of money and free time, she decided to quit streaming and returned to her former lifestyle, ultimately rekindling her original dream of becoming a journalist.

However, she found herself with less personal^00time and even ended up unintentionally hurting^00her friends. After reconsidering the true value of money and free^00time, she decided to quit streaming and returned to her former lifestyle,^00ultimately rekindling her original dream of becoming a journalist.

records.jp: 〇しほりの人となり^00独特の雰囲気を持つ、スタイル抜群の美少女。^00ファッションに詳しく、美容の相談によく乗ってくれる。^00男友達も多く、しばしば二人きりで出かけるのだが、^00しほりにとってはそんな彼ら全員が友人に過ぎない。
records.en_original: About Shihori^00A stunningly beautiful girl with a unique aura. She's well-versed in fashion and often offers great beauty advice. She has many male friends and frequently hangs out with them one-on-one, but to Shihori, all of them are nothing more than friends.
records.en: About Shihori A stunningly^00beautiful girl with a unique aura. She's well-versed^00in fashion and often offers great beauty advice. She has many^00male friends and frequently hangs out with them one-on-one,^00but to Shihori, all of them are nothing more than friends.

records.jp: 〇こだわりとすれ違い^00しほりが化粧や着こなしの研究を進めている理由は、^00もっとキレイになりたいという向上心や、^00キレイになる方法をシェアしたいというまごころから。^00だが、モテるということもあり、周りの女子生徒からは^00容姿で男子に媚びていると思われがち。
records.en_original: Commitment and Misunderstandings^00Shihori keeps up with the latest in makeup and clothes due to her aspiration to continually improve her beauty, as well as a desire to share that knowledge with others. However, due to her popularity with boys, other girls tend to think that Shihori only keeps up her looks to flirt.
records.en: Commitment and Misunderstandings Shihori^00keeps up with the latest in makeup and clothes^00due to her aspiration to continually improve her^00beauty, as well as a desire to share that knowledge with others.^00However, due to her popularity with boys, other girls tend to think^00that Shihori only keeps up her looks to flirt.

records.jp: 〇愛情表現の方向性^00突然下着を確認しようとしたり、^00お互いの下着を密かに交換したりするなど、^00日菜子に対し、しほりはしばしば奇行に走る。^00すべて彼女に対する心からの愛情によるものでは^00あるが、その度合いはかなり行き過ぎている。
records.en_original: Affectionate Behavior^00Shihori often acts oddly toward Hinako, such as suddenly trying to check her underwear or secretly swapping their underwear. While all of this stems from her genuine affection for Hinako, her actions are rather excessive.
records.en: Affectionate Behavior Shihori often^00acts oddly toward Hinako,^00such as suddenly trying to check her^00underwear or secretly swapping their underwear.^00While all of this stems from her genuine affection^00for Hinako, her actions are rather excessive.

records.jp: 〇千紘の人となり^00何を考えているかわからない、いわゆる不思議ちゃん。^00他人とのコミュニケーションが少し苦手。^00クラス内にお手製のぬいぐるみを飾るなど、^00周りから見ると謎の行動を取りがち。^00千紘に悪意は無く、純粋な親切心から実行に移している。^00手芸部に所属しており、器用さはピカイチ。
records.en_original: About Chihiro^00Chihiro is a bit of an enigma and hard to read. She's not very good at communicating with others. She often does things that baffle those around her, like displaying her handmade stuffed animals in the classroom. Chihiro never means any harm—she acts purely out of genuine kindness. She's a member of the crafts club and is exceptionally skilled with her hands.

records.jp: 〇優しさゆえの損な役回り^00クラスで発生した盗難事件で、犯人ではないかと^00疑いの目を向けられ、いじめを受ける。^00しかし実際には、彼女は真犯人を知っていた。^00クラスに軋轢が生まれることを恐れ、^00真実を言い出せずにいたのだった。
records.en_original: The Unfortunate Role That Kindness Brings^00During a series of thefts in her class, she was suspected of being the culprit and became a target of bullying. In reality, however, she knew who the real culprit was. Afraid of causing discord among her classmates, she couldn't bring herself to reveal the truth.
records.en: The Unfortunate Role That Kindness^00Brings During a series of thefts in her class, she was suspected^00of being the culprit and became a target of bullying.^00In reality, however, she knew who the real culprit was.^00Afraid of causing discord among her classmates,^00she couldn't bring herself to reveal the truth.

records.jp: 〇交流の第一歩^00千紘も、本心のところでは、自分の気持ちを^00上手く伝えられるようになりたいと思い続けてきた。^00日菜子からのアドバイスを受け、花壇の世話をはじめ、^00他人から認められる経験を積んでいった彼女は、^00ついに初対面の人と連絡先を交換できるようになった。
records.en_original: Step One to Building Bonds^00Deep down, Chihiro had always wished she could express her feelings more clearly. After following Hinako's advice and starting to take care of the flowerbeds, she gradually became recognized by others and finally was able to exchange contact information with someone she had just met for the first time.
records.en: Step One to Building^00Bonds Deep down, Chihiro had always wished she^00could express her feelings more clearly. After following Hinako's^00advice and starting to take care of the flowerbeds, she gradually became^00recognized by others and finally was able to exchange^00contact information with someone she had just met for the first time.

records.jp: 〇史緒の人となり^00特待科に通う、絶対音感を備えたピアニスト。^00裕福な家に生まれた史緒は、祖母の厳しい教育の下、^00幼少期からピアノを続けている。^00考えていることや本音を零してしまう癖があり、^00これが原因で人を苛立たせてしまうこともしばしば。
records.en_original: About Fumio^00A pianist with perfect pitch who attends the special class at Hoshinomiya. Born into a wealthy family, Fumio has played the piano since childhood under her grandmother's strict guidance. She has a habit of blurting out whatever she's thinking or feeling, which often ends up irritating those around her.

records.jp: 〇デスマーチへの親しみ^00理想の音を出すことにどこまでも執着している史緒は、^00ＳＥである父の影響を受け、それを追究する手段として^00デスマーチを採用。体力が保たず、ついに倒れてしまう。^00暴走を抑えてもらった後、聴衆のことを考えた音作りに^00取り組み始めるが、迷惑になっていると気づかないまま^00日菜子を巻き込む猪突猛進ぶりは元のままだった。
records.en_original: Love for Death Marches^00Fumio, who is endlessly obsessed with creating music exactly as she hears in her head, was influenced by her father, who is a systems engineer, and adopted the death march as a way to pursue her goals. Unable to keep up physically, she eventually collapsed. Even after her rampant Fragment was stabilized and she began to think of her audience while performing, her headlong approach to things has remained unchanged, and she drags Hinako along without realizing she is causing trouble for her.

records.jp: 〇憎たらしいほどのタレント^00プログラミングから料理まで、理想の音作りの参考に^00なりそうと思えばすぐ手を出すが、取捨選択は苦手。^00自分のキャパを超えたタスクを抱えては、パンク寸前^00の状態に陥っている。とはいえ、持ち前の天才っぷり^00をいかんなく発揮し、パンク寸前の状態のまま、^00すべてを上手くこなしてしまう。
records.en_original: Infuriatingly Gifted Talent^00From programming to cooking, if something seems like it could help Fumio craft her ideal music, she'll jump right in. However, she struggles with choosing what to focus on and often takes on more tasks than she can handle, constantly teetering on the brink of burnout. Even so, thanks to her natural genius, she manages to handle everything flawlessly—even when pushed to the limit.

records.jp: 〇香織の人となり^00何事にもあまり打ち込めず、緩い生活を送っている少女。^00ネット掲示板の閲覧やスマホゲームのプレイが日課。^00中学時代は梨佳と同じ陸上部の所属だったが、高校では^00引退してしまっている。^00派手な見た目に反して、根は真面目。
records.en_original: About Kaori^00A girl who lives a laid-back life, not really getting absorbed in anything. Her daily routine includes browsing online message boards and playing smartphone games. She was a member of the track and field club with Rika in junior high, but she stopped since entering high school. Despite her flashy appearance, she's actually quite serious at heart.

Despite her^00flashy appearance, she's actually quite serious at heart.

records.jp: 〇陸上競技との距離^00香織が陸上部を引退したのは、越えられそうにない壁に^00直面し、挫折してしまったからだった。結果の出ない^00努力は無意味だと走ることを諦めた彼女は、いつしか、^00どれだけ勝てなくても陸上を辞めない梨佳に対し、^00憧れと嫉妬の両方を抱くようになった。その想いが、^00彼女を陸上からさらに遠ざける原因にもなっていた。
records.en_original: Distance from Track and Field^00Kaori quit the track team after facing an insurmountable wall and succumbing to frustration. Convinced that effort without results was meaningless, she gave up running. Over time, she began to harbor both admiration and jealousy toward Rika, who never gave up track no matter how many times she lost. These feelings only widened the distance between Kaori and the world of track and field.

records.jp: 〇大切なのは「あなた自身が何者か」^00オタク趣味が興じ、コスプレにも挑戦している。^00とやかく言われがちな趣味を持っていることもあり、^00何かに対して偏見を持っている人は苦手。^00彼女自身も偏見を持たないよう心掛けており、^00年齢や性別にかかわらず友達を作っている。^00正真正銘の「いい人」である。
records.en_original: What Matters Most Is Who You Truly Are^00Kaori got into otaku hobbies and even started trying out cosplay. Because her hobbies are often the subject of criticism, she's not comfortable around people with prejudices. She tries hard not to judge anyone herself, making friends regardless of age or gender. She's a genuinely good person.

records.jp: 〇梨佳の人となり^00陸上部に所属している少女。^00足はそれほど速くないが、走ること自体が大好き。^00勝ち負けに関係なく部活を楽しんでいる。^00様々な流行に敏感な今どきの女子高生だが、^00本人は「普通」であることを気にしている。
records.en_original: About Rika^00A girl who's a member of the track and field club. She isn’t particularly fast, but she loves running for its own sake and enjoys club activities regardless of whether she wins or loses. Though she's a modern high school girl who's aware of the latest trends, she's a bit concerned about being too ordinary.

records.jp: 〇香織とのすれ違い^00中学の陸上部では香織と一緒に走っていた。そのため、^00高校に入り陸上を辞めてしまった彼女のことが気がかり。^00もう一度一緒に走ろうと何度も勧誘しているが、^00そのたびに断られている。
records.en_original: Drifting Apart from Kaori^00Rika used to run together with Kaori on the track team in junior high, which is why she's concerned about Kaori now that she's quit track in high school. Rika has invited Kaori to run with her again many times, but she always turns her down.
records.en: Drifting Apart from Kaori^00Rika used to run together with Kaori on the track team in junior high,^00which is why she's concerned about Kaori now that she's quit track in high^00school. Rika has invited Kaori to run with her again many times,^00but she always turns her down.

records.jp: 〇思いやりゆえの苦悩と走る喜び^00陸上競技の記録が更新できず、ほかの部員と自分を^00比べ始めた梨佳は、この嫉妬が誰かを傷つけるのではと^00不安を募らせ、集団トレーニングから距離を置いていた。^00これも、彼女の深い思いやりからの行動である。^00日菜子との交流を通じ、走る喜びを取り戻した彼女は、^00孤独なトレーニングを止め、部員との交流を再開した。
records.en_original: The Agony Born from Compassion and the Joy of Running^00Unable to improve her track and field records, Rika began comparing herself to the other club members. After growing anxious that her jealousy might lead to her hurting someone, she distanced herself from group training—an action stemming from her profound compassion. However, through her interactions with Hinako, she rediscovered the joy of running and returned to group training, reconnecting with her teammates.

records.jp: 〇司城教授の来歴^00夕月と来夢の父親。^00考古学者であり、原種とコモンに関し深い知識を持つ。^00娘二人を被験体とする、現実世界とコモンの接続実験を^00行った。その結果、姉妹はコモンへ到達したが、^00現実世界においては命を落としてしまった。
records.en_original: Professor Shijou's Background^00Professor Shijou is Yuzu and Lime's father and an archaeologist with extensive knowledge of Sephira and the Common. He conducted experiments to connect the real world and the Common, using his two daughters as test subjects. As a result, the sisters reached the Common, but lost their lives in the real world.

records.jp: 〇陽桜莉の人となり^00月ノ宮女子高等学校に通う、明るく、まっすぐな少女。^00困っている人を放っておけない性格をしている。^00幼い頃に父を亡くし、その後母も失踪。姉である美弦と^00二人で生活していたが、彼女も最近姿を消してしまった。^00姉が残した青い指輪を肌身離さず身に着けつつ、^00今は高校の女子寮で暮らしている。
records.en_original: About Hiori^00A bright and straightforward girl attending Tsukinomiya Girls' High School. She has a compassionate nature and can't ignore someone in need. She lost her father at a young age, and her mother disappeared soon after. She lived with her older sister, Mio, but lately, her sister has gone missing as well. Clinging to the blue ring her sister left behind, she now lives in the girls' dormitory at her high school.

records.jp: 〇リフレクター活動の開始^00学校の屋上で詩に襲われている都を助けた際、^00持っていた指輪の力でリフレクターに変身してしまう。^00最近月ノ宮で少女たちの想いを狙う集団がいること、^00リフレクターはその事件を追っていることを百から^00聞かされた陽桜莉は、困っている人を放っておけないと^00考え、謎の勢力との対峙を即決した。
records.en_original: The Start of Reflector Activities^00When Hiori saved Miyako, who was being attacked by Uta on the school rooftop, she accidentally transformed into a Reflector using the power of the ring she was carrying. Hiori then learned from Momo that recently a group in Tsukinomiya has been targeting girls' feelings, and that the Reflectors are tailing these incidents. Unable to ignore people in trouble, Hiori immediately decided to confront this mysterious force.

Unable to ignore people in trouble,^00Hiori immediately decided to confront this mysterious force.

records.jp: 〇姉との対峙と友人からのサポート^00陽桜莉らと対立する謎の集団に、美弦が所属していた。^00元々抱え込みやすい性格の彼女は、姉との対立による^00動揺を悟られないよう、今まで以上に明るく振る舞う。^00それでも、黒幕である紫乃と共に姉が姿を消し、^00頼れる百が昏睡状態に陥ると、心に隠せない傷を負った。^00そんな彼女を、瑠夏や都が支えている。
records.en_original: Confrontation with Her Sister and Support from Friends^00Mio was a member of the mysterious group opposing Hiori and her friends. Naturally prone to bottling up her feelings, Hiori put on an even brighter front than usual to hide her agitation over the conflict with her sister. However, when her sister disappeared along with Shino—the mastermind behind everything—and her trusted friend Momo fell into a coma, she suffered a wound in her heart she could no longer conceal. Ruka and Miyako support her through these difficult times.

records.jp: 〇世界の真実と自責思考^00新たに友人となった涼楓・亜未琉との敵対は、陽桜莉の^00心に傷を加えた。敵から寝返った仁菜は、動揺する^00彼女に戦う覚悟を求め、あえて残酷な真実を伝える。^00この世界は一度時間が巻き戻っており、前の時空では^00彼女のせいで美弦が死んでいた。さらなる衝撃を受けた^00彼女は、自責の念から、ついに想いを暴走させてしまう。
records.en_original: The Truth of the World and Remorseful Thoughts^00The enmity of Ryoka and Amiru, who had just become her friends, left a wound on Hiori's heart. Niina, who had defected from the enemy, demanded that Hiori find the resolve to fight, deliberately revealing a harsh truth: time in this world had been rewound once before, and in the previous timeline, Mio had died because of her. Stricken by this revelation, Hiori's remorse overwhelmed her, and her feelings finally went rampant.
records.en: The Truth of the World and Remorseful Thoughts The enmity of Ryoka^00and Amiru, who had just become her friends, left a wound on Hiori's heart.^00Niina, who had defected from the enemy, demanded that Hiori find^00the resolve to fight, deliberately revealing a harsh truth: time^00in this world had been rewound once before, and in the previous timeline,^00Mio had died because of her. Stricken by this revelation, Hiori's^00remorse overwhelmed her, and her feelings finally went rampant.

records.jp: 〇姉との和解と最終決戦^00自らの想いの暴走によってコモンと現実世界の扉こそ^00開けてしまったが、陽桜莉は、戦闘を通じ美弦との^00和解に成功した。心の傷を癒した陽桜莉は、^00コモンにて想い無き世界の創造を企む紫乃を止め、^00彼女の本当の願いに触れるべく、姉や瑠夏、^00そして復活した百ら仲間と共に戦いに挑む。
records.en_original: Reconciliation with Her Sister and the Final Battle^00Though her rampant emotions ended up opening the door between the Common and the real world, Hiori managed to reconcile with Mio through battle. Now healed from her emotional wounds, Hiori sets out into the Common to stop Shino, who seeks to create a world that's void of feelings. Joined by Mio, Ruka, and their revived companion Momo, Hiori prepares for the decisive battle, hoping to uncover Shino's true wish.
records.en: Reconciliation with Her Sister and the Final Battle Though her^00rampant emotions ended up opening the door between the Common^00and the real world, Hiori managed to reconcile with Mio through battle.^00Now healed from her emotional wounds, Hiori sets out into the Common to stop^00Shino, who seeks to create a world that's void of feelings.^00Joined by Mio, Ruka, and their revived companion Momo, Hiori prepares^00for the decisive battle, hoping to uncover Shino's true wish.

records.jp: 〇紫乃のいる新しい生活^00実はその昔、陽桜莉と紫乃は巡り逢っていた。^00コモンの奥地でその事実を思い出した陽桜莉は、紫乃が^00その時抱えていた心の叫びを今度こそ聞き届けようと、^00彼女に手を差し伸べる。野望をついに食い止めた^00陽桜莉は、平穏を取り戻した月ノ宮で、瑠夏や都に加え^00紫乃とも仲睦まじく、新たな生活を送り始めるのだった。
records.en_original: A New Life with Shino^00Long ago, Hiori and Shino actually crossed paths. Deep within the Common, Hiori recalls this fact, and this time, she reaches out to Shino, determined to finally listen to the cries from her heart. Having put an end to Shino's ambitions at last, Hiori begins a new peaceful life together with Ruka, Miyako, and Shino at Tsukinomiya.
records.en: A New Life with Shino Long^00ago, Hiori and Shino actually crossed paths.^00Deep within the Common, Hiori recalls this fact, and this^00time, she reaches out to Shino, determined to finally^00listen to the cries from her heart. Having put^00an end to Shino's ambitions at last, Hiori begins a new peaceful^00life together with Ruka, Miyako, and Shino at Tsukinomiya.

records.jp: 〇瑠夏の人となり^00月ノ宮女子高等学校に転校してきた少女。^00女子寮では陽桜莉と部屋をシェアしている。^00転勤族の両親に付き従ってきたため、同年代の人と^00深い関係を築けた経験がない。そのことに悶々と悩んで^00いたところ、街中でたまたま百とぶつかってしまう。^00その際、彼女が落とした青い指輪を拾った。
records.en_original: About Ruka^00A girl who transferred to Tsukinomiya Girls' High School. She shares a dorm room with Hiori. Because she has always moved around with her parents, who work in jobs that require frequent relocation, she has never formed any deep relationships with people her own age. While dwelling on this, she bumped into Momo by chance in town and picked up a blue ring that Momo had dropped.
records.en: About Ruka A girl^00who transferred to Tsukinomiya Girls' High School.^00She shares a dorm room with Hiori. Because she has always moved^00around with her parents, who work in jobs that require frequent^00relocation, she has never formed any deep relationships with people^00her own age. While dwelling on this, she bumped into Momo by chance^00in town and picked up a blue ring that Momo had dropped.

records.jp: 〇リフレクターになったきっかけ^00悩み苦しんでいる人に声を掛けられなかったことを、^00瑠夏は後悔し続けてきた。陽桜莉と出会い、彼女の、^00困っている人は放っておけないという想いに触れ、^00瑠夏は、自分も変わりたいと強く願う。その時、^00青い指輪の力で、彼女はリフレクターとして覚醒した。
records.en_original: What Led Her to Become a Reflector^00Ruka had always regretted not being able to reach out to those who were suffering or troubled. After meeting Hiori and being touched by her determination to never abandon someone in need, Ruka began to truly wish she could change as well. At that moment, the power of the blue ring awakened her abilities as a Reflector.
records.en: What Led Her to Become a Reflector Ruka^00had always regretted not being able to reach out to those^00who were suffering or troubled. After meeting Hiori and being touched^00by her determination to never abandon someone in need, Ruka^00began to truly wish she could change as well. At that moment,^00the power of the blue ring awakened her abilities as a Reflector.

records.jp: 〇陽桜莉のバディ^00寮・学校での共同生活やバディを組んでの戦闘を通じ、^00瑠夏にとって陽桜莉は友達以上の大切な存在になった。^00陽桜莉が抱く姉への想いを知っているからこそ、^00彼女の想いを脆さだと考え、幸せの形を決めつける^00美弦に対して強く憤った。一時は戦えないほど^00ショックを受けた彼女のため、瑠夏は隣に立ち続ける。
records.en_original: Hiori’s Partner^00Through living together in the dormitory and at school, as well as battling side by side as partners, Hiori became more than just a friend to Ruka—she became someone truly special. Because she understands the feelings Hiori has for her older sister, Ruka was deeply angered by Mio, who dismissed those feelings as weakness and tried to define happiness for her. When Hiori was so shaken by the confrontation that she could no longer fight, Ruka remained by her side.
records.en: Hiori’s Partner Through living together in the dormitory and at school,^00as well as battling side by side as partners, Hiori became more^00than just a friend to Ruka—she became someone truly special.^00Because she understands the feelings Hiori has for her older sister, Ruka^00was deeply angered by Mio, who dismissed those feelings as weakness^00and tried to define happiness for her. When Hiori was so shaken^00by the confrontation that she could no longer fight, Ruka remained by her side.

records.jp: 〇紫乃との対峙^00悪意のない世界を創る。そんな紫乃の想いを瑠夏は否定^00しない。それでも彼女は、この世界に数多ある想いを^00守ると決めた。想いを守り、平和になった世界で^00陽桜莉と生きていく。その約束を果たすため、彼女は^00コモンで紫乃と対峙する覚悟を固めた。
records.en_original: Confrontation with Shino^00Creating a world without malice—that is Shino's wish, and Ruka does not reject the notion. Even so, she has resolved to protect the countless feelings that exist in this world. She promised to guard those emotions and live together with Hiori in a peaceful world, and in order to fulfill that promise, she steels herself for a confrontation with Shino in the Common.
records.en: Confrontation with Shino Creating a world without malice—that is Shino's^00wish, and Ruka does not reject the notion. Even so, she^00has resolved to protect the countless feelings that exist in this^00world. She promised to guard those emotions and live together^00with Hiori in a peaceful world, and in order to fulfill that promise,^00she steels herself for a confrontation with Shino in the Common.

records.jp: 〇都の人となり^00月ノ宮女子高等学校に通う少女。^00実家は裕福であり、友人たちから羨ましがられている。^00しかし、両親は彼女の優秀な兄ばかりかわいがっており、^00都本人は家の中に居場所がない状態。^00学校でも家庭でも自分を分かってもらえず、^00常に寂しさを募らせている。
records.en_original: About Miyako^00A girl attending Tsukinomiya Girls' High School. Her family is wealthy, making her the envy of her friends. However, her parents only dote on her outstanding older brother, leaving Miyako feeling out of place at home. She feels understood neither at school nor at home, and is constantly growing lonelier.
records.en: About Miyako A girl^00attending Tsukinomiya Girls' High^00School. Her family is wealthy, making her the envy of her friends.^00However, her parents only dote on her outstanding older brother,^00leaving Miyako feeling out of place at home.^00She feels understood neither at school nor at home,^00and is constantly growing lonelier.

records.jp: 〇陽桜莉や瑠夏との交流^00精神的に追い詰められている都の想いを奪おうと^00詩と仁菜が二度も襲い掛かるが、いずれにおいても^00陽桜莉と瑠夏が彼女を助け出した。^00信頼できる友人を二人も得た彼女は、実家から^00陽桜莉・瑠夏の生活する女子寮へと移り住む。現在は^00情報収集を通じ二人のリフレクター活動を支えている。
records.en_original: Interaction with Hiori and Ruka^00Uta and Niina attacked Miyako twice, aiming to steal her Fragment while she was emotionally cornered. However, Hiori and Ruka came to her rescue both times. Now that she has two trustworthy friends, she moves out of her family home and into the girls' dorm where Hiori and Ruka live. Currently, she supports their activities as Reflectors by gathering information.
records.en: Interaction with Hiori and Ruka^00Uta and Niina attacked Miyako twice, aiming to steal her^00Fragment while she was emotionally cornered. However, Hiori and Ruka^00came to her rescue both times. Now that she^00has two trustworthy friends, she moves out of her family home^00and into the girls' dorm where Hiori and Ruka live. Currently, she^00supports their activities as Reflectors by gathering information.

records.jp: 〇頭脳と行動力^00リフレクター二人をサポートするようになってからは、^00チームの参謀的な存在になっている。意見が食い違うと^00拗ねて部屋を飛び出してしまうなど、少しわがままで^00短気な部分はあるが、根っこは仲間想いで心配性。^00寮に侵入した詩をフライパンで殴り倒すなど、^00行動力も持ち合わせている。
records.en_original: Brains and Initiative^00Since she started supporting the two Reflectors, Miyako has taken on a strategic role within the team. While she can be a bit selfish and quick-tempered—sometimes even storming out of the room when disagreements arise—at heart, she cares deeply about her friends and worries about them. She's also not afraid to take action, one time knocking out Uta—who had snuck into the dorm—with a frying pan.
records.en: Brains and Initiative Since she started supporting the two^00Reflectors, Miyako has taken on a strategic role within the team.^00While she can be a bit selfish and quick-tempered—sometimes^00even storming out of the room when disagreements^00arise—at heart, she cares deeply about her friends and worries^00about them. She's also not afraid to take action, one time^00knocking out Uta—who had snuck into the dorm—with a frying pan.

records.jp: 〇コンプレックスと仲間への想い^00リフレクターに変身できないことを内心気にしており、^00陽桜莉や瑠夏のことを羨ましく思うと同時に、自分が^00二人と共に戦えないことを悔しく思っている。^00彼女たちがコモンへ突入する直前、そんな想いを^00打ち明けつつ、励ましの言葉を送った。
records.en_original: Insecurities and Feelings Toward Her Friends^00Although she doesn't show it, Miyako is secretly bothered by her inability to transform into a Reflector. She envies Hiori and Ruka, and is sad that she can't fight alongside them. Just before they entered the Common, she confessed these feelings to them and offered words of encouragement.
records.en: Insecurities and Feelings Toward Her^00Friends Although she doesn't show it, Miyako is secretly bothered^00by her inability to transform into a Reflector. She envies Hiori^00and Ruka, and is sad that she can't fight alongside them.^00Just before they entered the Common, she confessed these^00feelings to them and offered words of encouragement.

records.jp: 〇百の人となり^00研究機関ＡＡＳＡに所属するリフレクターの少女。^00人々の想いが危機に瀕している中、ＡＡＳＡの指示の^00もと、月ノ宮で起きていた少女襲撃事件を追っていた。^00街中で瑠夏とぶつかった際、青い指輪を落としたことで、^00結果的に彼女がリフレクターになるきっかけを作った。^00リフレクターの先輩として、陽桜莉と瑠夏を支えている。
records.en_original: About Momo^00A Reflector who's affiliated with the research organization AASA. With people’s hopes in jeopardy, she investigated a series of attacks on girls in Tsukinomiya under AASA's orders. When she bumped into Ruka in town and dropped her blue ring, it ultimately led to Ruka becoming a Reflector. She supports both Hiori and Ruka as an experienced Reflector.
records.en: About Momo^00A Reflector who's affiliated with the research organization^00AASA. With people’s hopes in jeopardy, she investigated^00a series of attacks on girls in Tsukinomiya under AASA's^00orders. When she bumped into Ruka in town and dropped her^00blue ring, it ultimately led to Ruka becoming a Reflector.^00She supports both Hiori and Ruka as an experienced Reflector.

records.jp: 〇時間が巻き戻る前の人間関係^00敵対していた美弦との接触を通し、この世界は時間が^00一度巻き戻っていることを悟った百は動揺する。^00巻き戻る前の時空では、想いが暴走していたところを^00美弦に救われている。その一件がきっかけとなり、^00彼女もリフレクターとなった。その後は美弦と二人で^00戦っていたが、ある戦闘で敗北した際死亡してしまう。
records.en_original: Relationships Before Time Was Reversed^00Through her encounters with Mio, who is acting as her enemy, Momo realizes that time in this world has been rewound, leaving her deeply shaken. In the timeline before the rewind, Mio saved her when her emotions were going rampant. That incident became the catalyst for her to become a Reflector as well. Afterward, she fought alongside Mio, but ultimately died after they were defeated in a battle.
records.en: Relationships Before Time Was Reversed Through^00her encounters with Mio, who is acting as her enemy, Momo^00realizes that time in this world has been rewound, leaving her^00deeply shaken. In the timeline before the rewind, Mio saved her^00when her emotions were going rampant. That incident became the catalyst^00for her to become a Reflector as well. Afterward, she fought^00alongside Mio, but ultimately died after they were defeated in a battle.

records.jp: 〇礼拝堂での戦いの帰結^00バディとして美弦と過ごした日々を思い出したことで、^00百は本来の力を取り戻した。その実力は仁菜や詩を圧倒^00していたが、聖イネス学園での戦いにて、美弦の攻撃^00から陽桜莉を庇った結果、自身のフラグメントが砕け^00昏睡状態に陥ってしまう。
records.en_original: Outcome of the Battle at the Chapel^00Recalling the days she spent with Mio as partners brought back Momo's original strength. Her power easily overwhelmed Niina and Uta; however, during the battle at St. Ines Academy, she shielded Hiori from Mio's attack, resulting in her own Fragment being shattered and her falling into a coma.
records.en: Outcome of the Battle at the Chapel^00Recalling the days she spent with Mio as partners brought back^00Momo's original strength. Her power easily overwhelmed Niina and Uta;^00however, during the battle at St. Ines Academy, she shielded^00Hiori from Mio's attack, resulting in her own Fragment being shattered^00and her falling into a coma.

records.jp: 〇美弦の想いと目覚め^00フラグメントが壊れ、眠り続ける百を目覚めさせたのは^00陽桜莉と和解した後の美弦だった。彼女は、破壊された^00百のフラグメントの一部を胸の中に隠していたのだった。^00目覚めてほしいという彼女の想いに応えるかのごとく、^00その欠片を元手に、百は復活した。その後のコモンでの^00決戦には、美弦とバディを組み、参戦している。
records.en_original: Mio's Feelings and the Awakening^00It was Mio reconciling with Hiori that finally awakened Momo from her endless slumber after her Fragment had been destroyed. Mio had secretly kept a part of the destroyed Fragment within her heart, and her heartfelt wish for Momo to awaken caused the shard to revive her. Afterwards, Mio teamed up with her as partners and they joined the decisive battle in the Common.
records.en: Mio's Feelings and the Awakening^00It was Mio reconciling with Hiori that finally awakened^00Momo from her endless slumber after her Fragment had been destroyed.^00Mio had secretly kept a part of the destroyed Fragment within^00her heart, and her heartfelt wish for Momo to awaken caused^00the shard to revive her. Afterwards, Mio teamed up with her as partners^00and they joined the decisive battle in the Common.

records.jp: 〇美弦の人となり^00陽桜莉の実の姉。両親がどちらもいない環境において^00妹のことを大切に思い、二人で暮らしてきた。しかし、^00そんな彼女も陽桜莉の前から姿を消してしまう。^00七夕の夜、陽桜莉が姉の姿を再び認めた時、彼女は^00赤い指輪を嵌めたリフレクターとして活動していた。^00すなわち、敵として妹の前に現れたのである。
records.en_original: About Mio^00Hiori's older sister. Having lost both of their parents, she cherished her younger sister and the two lived together. However, even she eventually disappeared from Hiori's life. On the night of Tanabata, when Hiori saw her sister again, she found her acting as a Reflector with a red ring—in other words, an enemy.
records.en: About Mio Hiori's^00older sister. Having lost both of their parents, she^00cherished her younger sister and the two lived together.^00However, even she eventually disappeared^00from Hiori's life. On the night of Tanabata, when Hiori^00saw her sister again, she found her acting as a Reflector^00with a red ring—in other words, an enemy.

records.jp: 〇時間が巻き戻る前の悲劇^00美弦は、この世界の時間が一度巻き戻っていると知って^00いた。前の時空において、彼女は、百と共に青い指輪の^00力を利用し人々を救っていたが、活動に没頭しすぎ、^00良かれと思い女子寮へ送り込んだ妹の孤独を見過ごして^00しまう。想いが暴走した後の妹を目撃し、絶望に沈んだ^00彼女は、その後の戦いに敗北し命を落としてしまった。
records.en_original: The Tragedy Before Time Rewound^00Mio knew that time in this world had been rewound once before. In the previous timeline, she and Momo had used the power of the blue rings to save people. However, Mio became too absorbed in these activities and, thinking it was for the best, sent her younger sister to the girls' dormitory, overlooking her loneliness. After witnessing her sister's emotions go rampant, Mio fell into despair and, following a subsequent defeat in battle, lost her life.
records.en: The Tragedy Before Time Rewound Mio knew that time in this world^00had been rewound once before. In the previous timeline, she and Momo had used^00the power of the blue rings to save people. However, Mio became too^00absorbed in these activities and, thinking it was for the best, sent her^00younger sister to the girls' dormitory, overlooking her loneliness.^00After witnessing her sister's emotions go rampant, Mio fell into^00despair and, following a subsequent defeat in battle, lost her life.

records.jp: 〇紫乃への追従^00時間が巻き戻った後、溺愛する陽桜莉の想いを二度と^00暴走させないと誓った美弦は、紫乃の「すべての想いを^00管理する」計画に賛同し、彼女に付き従い始める。^00少女たちの想いを抜いていたのも、想いを管理し、妹を^00絶対に絶望させないためであった。しかし、紫乃に心を^00掌握され、その想いすら見失ってしまう。
records.en_original: Following Shino^00After time was rewound, Mio swore never to let her beloved Hiori's feelings go rampant again. Agreeing with Shino's plan to "manage all emotions," she began to follow her. The reason she was extracting the girls' feelings was to manage emotions and make sure her little sister would never fall into despair. However, under Shino's influence, even that conviction was lost as her heart became completely dominated.
records.en: Following Shino After^00time was rewound, Mio swore never to let her beloved Hiori's feelings^00go rampant again. Agreeing with Shino's plan to "manage all emotions,"^00she began to follow her. The reason she was extracting the girls'^00feelings was to manage emotions and make sure her younger sister would never^00fall into despair. However, under Shino's influence, even that conviction^00was lost as her heart became completely dominated.

records.jp: 〇陽桜莉とのすれ違いの解消^00陽桜莉を絶望させないという美弦の望みは、妹を失う^00恐怖の裏返しでもある。彼女もまた、恐れや苦しみと^00向き合わず逃げ出そうとする弱い少女だった。そんな^00姉の本当の姿を知ってなお寄り添おうとする陽桜莉の^00姿を通し、彼女は初めて自分の過ちに気が付き、紫乃の^00支配から脱する。
records.en_original: Resolving the Rift with Hiori^00Mio's wish to never let Hiori fall into despair is actually a reflection of her own fear of losing her little sister. Deep down, she was just a vulnerable girl, trying to avoid facing her own fears and pain by running away. Yet, after seeing Hiori's willingness to stay by her side even after learning her true self, Mio finally realizes her own mistakes and breaks free from Shino's control.
records.en: Resolving the Rift with Hiori Mio's^00wish to never let Hiori fall into despair is actually a reflection of her^00own fear of losing her younger sister. Deep down, she was just a vulnerable^00girl, trying to avoid facing her own fears and pain by running away.^00Yet, after seeing Hiori's willingness to stay by her side even after^00learning her true self, Mio finally realizes her own mistakes and breaks free^00from Shino's control.

records.jp: 〇最終決戦に向けた決意^00美弦は、陽桜莉らと和解し、束の間の平穏を享受した後、^00妹の傍で彼女の幸せを見守るために、そして、前の時空^00では救えなかった紫乃を助けるために、百らとコモンへ^00突入し、紫乃との最終決戦に挑んだ。^00戦いの最中、彼女は自分のフラグメントを犠牲に、^00紫乃の障壁を粉砕。妹らに後を託して消えたのだった。
records.en_original: Resolve During the Final Battle^00After reconciling with Hiori and the others and enjoying a brief moment of peace, Mio entered the Common with Momo and the others. She did so to watch over her sister's happiness by her side and to save Shino, who she wasn't able to save in the previous timeline. There, she challenged Shino to a final showdown. During the battle, Mio sacrificed her own Fragment to shatter Shino's barrier. Entrusting everything to her sister and the others, she disappeared.
records.en: Resolve During the Final Battle After reconciling with Hiori and the others^00and enjoying a brief moment of peace, Mio entered the Common with Momo^00and the others. She did so to watch over her sister's happiness^00by her side and to save Shino, who she wasn't able to save in the previous^00timeline. There, she challenged Shino to a final showdown. During^00the battle, Mio sacrificed her own Fragment to shatter Shino's barrier.^00Entrusting everything to her sister and the others, she disappeared.

records.jp: 〇最終決戦後の美弦^00自らのフラグメントを代償に紫乃を食い止めた美弦は、^00戦いの後、自分が誰ともわからない状態で街中を^00ふらついていた。そこを、彼女を懸命に追っていた^00陽桜莉に見つけられ、保護される。最終的に、陽桜莉の^00中に眠っていた彼女のフラグメントを元手に、様々な^00人の協力の下、意識を取り戻すことに成功した。
records.en_original: Mio After the Final Battle^00Mio, who had sacrificed her own Fragment to stop Shino, was left wandering the city in a dazed state, with no memory of who she was. She was eventually found and taken in by Hiori, who had been desperately searching for her. In the end, with help from everyone and by using the part of Mio's Fragment that had lain dormant within Hiori, she was able to return to her normal self.
records.en: Mio After the Final Battle^00Mio, who had sacrificed her own Fragment to stop Shino, was left^00wandering the city in a dazed state, with no memory of who she^00was. She was eventually found and taken in by Hiori,^00who had been desperately searching for her. In the end, with help from everyone^00and by using the part of Mio's Fragment that had lain dormant^00within Hiori, she was able to return to her normal self.

records.jp: 〇仁菜の人となり^00赤い指輪の力を使って変身するリフレクターの一人。^00バディである詩と共に、少女の想いを抜き続けている。^00美弦のことを「お姉さま」と呼び、強く慕っている。^00その理由は、劣悪な家庭環境から逃げ出してきた先で^00孤独と絶望から救ってくれたため。その美弦から勧誘^00され、彼女は人々の想いを奪うリフレクターになった。
records.en_original: About Niina^00One of the Reflectors who transforms using the power of a red ring. She extracts the feelings of girls together with her partner, Uta. She calls Mio "Sister" and admires her deeply, due to Mio having saved her from loneliness and despair after she had fled from a terrible home environment. After being invited by Mio, Niina becomes a Reflector who steals people's feelings.
records.en: About Niina^00One of the Reflectors who transforms using the power of a red ring.^00She extracts the feelings of girls together with her partner, Uta.^00She calls Mio "Onee-sama" and admires her deeply, due to Mio^00having saved her from loneliness and despair after she had fled^00from a terrible home environment. After being invited^00by Mio, Niina becomes a Reflector who steals people's feelings.

records.jp: 〇美弦との共鳴と陽桜莉への憎悪^00美弦と共鳴し、お互いの想いを共有した仁菜は、^00この世界の時間が一度巻き戻っているという事実と、^00前の時空において彼女が経験してきた事件を知った。^00愛する「お姉さま」の中にある苦悩の原因が^00妹の陽桜莉にあると悟った仁菜は、彼女に対し深い^00憎しみと敵意を抱くようになった。
records.en_original: Resonance with Mio and Hatred Toward Hiori^00Niina resonated with Mio, sharing each other's feelings. Through this, she learned that time in this world had been turned back once, and she came to know about the incidents Mio experienced in the previous timeline. Realizing that the cause of her beloved sister's suffering was her younger sister, Hiori, Niina began to harbor deep hatred and hostility toward her.
records.en: Resonance with Mio and Hatred Toward Hiori^00Niina resonated with Mio, sharing each other's feelings. Through^00this, she learned that time in this world had been turned back once,^00and she came to know about the incidents Mio experienced in the previous^00timeline. Realizing that the cause of her beloved^00Onee-sama's suffering was her younger sister, Hiori, Niina began to harbor^00deep hatred and hostility toward her.

records.jp: 〇陽桜莉への恩と成り行き上の共同生活^00陽桜莉のフラグメントを巡る聖イネス学園での戦いにて、^00憎んでいたはずの彼女自身に想いを救われた仁菜は、^00戦闘の後、紫乃の下を去り、これまでの活動から離れた。^00目的も、行く当てもないままに少女の想いを助けていた^00彼女は、偶然出会った陽桜莉の提案で、月ノ宮女子^00高等学校女子寮の空き部屋へ転がり込むことになった。
records.en_original: A Debt to Hiori and the Circumstances of Their Shared Life^00During the battle over Hiori's Fragment at St. Ines Academy, Niina—who once harbored hatred toward her—had her own heart saved by Hiori. After the battle, Niina left Shino and distanced herself from her previous activities. With no purpose or destination, she found herself helping girls with their feelings. It was then, by chance, that Hiori proposed she stay in an empty room at the Tsukinomiya Girls' High School dormitory, and Niina ended up moving in.
records.en: A Debt to Hiori and the Circumstances of Their Shared Life^00During the battle over Hiori's Fragment at St. Ines Academy, Niina—who once^00harbored hatred toward her—had her own heart saved by Hiori. After the battle,^00Niina left Shino and distanced herself from her previous activities. With no^00purpose or destination, she found herself helping girls with their feelings.^00It was then, by chance, that Hiori proposed she stay in an empty room^00at the Tsukinomiya Girls' High School dormitory, and Niina ended up moving in.

records.jp: 〇美弦との再会と共闘^00女子寮暮らしを続けている間に、愛しの美弦が妹の^00陽桜莉と和解し、仁菜と彼女は再び接近した。^00紫乃を助けたい。そんな美弦の想いに応えるため、^00彼女は平原姉妹らと共闘する道を選んだ。そんな決意に^00呼応するかのように、赤色だったはずの彼女の指輪は、^00いつしか青色へと変わっていた。
records.en_original: Reunion and Alliance with Mio^00While Niina continued her life in the girls' dormitory, her beloved Mio reconciled with her younger sister Hiori, drawing Niina and Mio close once again. Wishing to save Shino, Mio's feelings inspired Niina to join forces with the Hirahara sisters and their friends. As if resonating with her resolve, the red ring she once wore had, before she knew it, turned blue.
records.en: Reunion and Alliance with Mio^00While Niina continued her life in the girls' dormitory, her^00beloved Mio reconciled with her younger sister Hiori, drawing^00Niina and Mio close once again. Wishing to save Shino, Mio's^00feelings inspired Niina to join forces with the Hirahara sisters^00and their friends. As if resonating with her resolve, the red ring she once^00wore had, before she knew it, turned blue.

records.jp: 〇詩の人となり^00赤い指輪の力を使って変身するリフレクターの一人。^00バディである仁菜と共に、少女の想いを抜き続けている。^00敵対するリフレクターとして、陽桜莉が初めて対峙した^00相手だった。痛みこそが生きている実感を与えてくれる^00と思っているため、常に精神的、肉体的な痛みを求めているが、実は相手を攻撃することも好き。
records.en_original: About Uta^00One of the Reflectors who transforms using the power of a red ring. She steals emotions from girls together with her partner, Niina. She was the first Reflector that Hiori ever confronted as an enemy. She possesses a strong masochistic streak and delights in pain, whether mental or physical, but in truth, she also enjoys attacking others.
records.en: About Uta One of the Reflectors who transforms using^00the power of a red ring. She steals emotions from girls together^00with her partner, Niina. She was the first Reflector that Hiori^00ever confronted as an enemy. She possesses a strong^00masochistic streak and delights in pain, whether mental^00or physical, but in truth, she also enjoys attacking others.

records.jp: 〇痛みへの執着^00詩は幼少期から人の心というものが理解できずにいた。^00愛や優しさにも共感することができず、生の実感を^00得られない退屈な生活を送っていたある日、彼女は^00通り魔に襲われる。刃物で切られた際、生まれて^00初めて生きているという感触を得た彼女は、この一件^00以降、痛みというものに異様なほど執着していく。
records.en_original: Obsession with Pain^00Uta was unable to understand the hearts of others from a young age. She couldn't relate to love or kindness, and lived a dull life, unable to feel truly alive. One day, she was attacked by a random assailant. For the first time in her life, as she was cut by a blade, she felt what it meant to be alive. From that moment on, she developed an unusual obsession with pain.
records.en: Obsession with Pain^00Uta was unable to understand the hearts of others from a young age.^00She couldn't relate to love or kindness, and lived a dull^00life, unable to feel truly alive. One day, she was attacked^00by a random assailant. For the first time in her life, as^00she was cut by a blade, she felt what it meant to be alive.^00From that moment on, she developed an unusual obsession with pain.

records.jp: 〇紫乃への個人的関心^00紫乃や美弦が創り出そうとしている世界について、詩は^00ほとんど興味を抱いていない。彼女の興味の対象は紫乃^00本人である。悪を誰よりも軽蔑し、悪を滅ぼす自分こそ^00絶対的な正義だと確信している紫乃。どれほどの痛みが^00彼女にそのような思想を与えたのか。詩の興味の大半は、^00そこに向けられている。
records.en_original: Personal Interest in Shino^00Uta has little interest in the world that Shino and Mio are trying to create. Her interest lies solely in Shino herself. Shino, who despises evil more than anyone else and is convinced that destroying evil makes her the embodiment of absolute justice. What kind of pain drove her to adopt such beliefs? Most of Uta's curiosity is focused on that very question.
records.en: Personal Interest in Shino^00Uta has little interest in the world that Shino and Mio are trying to create.^00Her interest lies solely in Shino herself. Shino,^00who despises evil more than anyone else and is convinced that destroying^00evil makes her the embodiment of absolute justice. What^00kind of pain drove her to adopt such beliefs? Most of Uta's curiosity^00is focused on that very question.

records.jp: 〇紫乃の人となり^00聖イネス学園中等部に通う少女。美弦と仁菜、詩の^00三人に赤い指輪を渡して使役し、フラグメントを^00集めていた。^00大量に集めたフラグメントの力でコモンへの扉を開いた^00彼女は、理想とする「すべての想いを管理する世界」を^00創造し悪を消し去る寸前まで辿り着きつつあった。
records.en_original: About Shino^00A girl attending St. Ines Academy's middle school, who commanded Mio, Niina, and Uta to collect Fragments. She is also the one who gave the trio their red rings. Using the power of the many Fragments she gathered, she opened the door to the Common, coming close to creating her ideal world—a world where all feelings are managed—and erasing evil from existence.
records.en: About Shino A girl^00attending St. Ines Academy's middle school, who commanded Mio, Niina,^00and Uta to collect Fragments. She is also the one who gave^00the trio their red rings.^00Using the power of the many Fragments she gathered, she opened^00the door to the Common, coming close to creating her ideal world—a world^00where all feelings are managed—and erasing evil from existence.

records.jp: 〇思い出したくもない過去^00紫乃は、双子の姉である加乃と共に、母親から^00金儲けの道具として扱われてきた。挙句、姉の命は^00彼女の前で奪われてしまう。世界の時間が巻き戻る前に^00おいては、姉の死によって暴走したフラグメントを^00美弦が鎮めてくれたものの、彼女の苦しみは、^00その短い生涯の最期まで癒えることはなかった。
records.en_original: A Past She Wishes to Forget^00Shino's mother treated her as nothing more than a tool for making money, and in the end, took the life of her twin sister Kano right before her eyes. Before time in the world was rewound, Shino's Fragment went rampant due to her sister's death, and although Mio was able to calm it, Shino's pain never healed before the world came to an end.
records.en: A Past She Wishes to Forget^00Shino's mother treated her as nothing more than a tool^00for making money, and in the end, took the life of her twin^00sister Kano right before her eyes. Before time in the world^00was rewound, Shino's Fragment went rampant due to her sister's^00death, and although Mio was able to calm it,^00Shino's pain never healed before the world came to an end.

records.jp: 〇新世界創造の決意^00世界の時間が巻き戻った後、原種のビナーから力を^00注がれ、現在の計画を進めてきた紫乃は、コモン侵攻を^00開始する段階で、迷いを断つため自らのフラグメントを^00破壊した。喜びも悲しみも、すべての想いに別れを告げ、^00紫乃は一人、コモンの中へと消え去り、新世界創造の^00準備を始めたのだった。
records.en_original: Resolution to Create a New World^00After time in the world was turned back, Shino, who had been empowered by the Sephira Binah, continued with her current plan. At the point she began the invasion of the Common, she destroyed her own Fragment in order to cast away all doubts. Bidding farewell to all emotions—joy, sorrow, and everything in between—Shino disappeared alone into the Common and began preparations to create a new world.
records.en: Resolution to Create a New^00World After time in the world was turned back, Shino, who had been empowered^00by the Sephira Binah, continued with her current plan. At the point she^00began the invasion of the Common, she destroyed her own Fragment^00in order to cast away all doubts. Bidding farewell to all emotions—joy, sorrow,^00and everything in between—Shino disappeared alone into the Common and began^00preparations to create a new world.

records.jp: 〇陽桜莉たちとの和解と本当の願い^00手放したはずの想いは、陽桜莉らに回収されていた。^00コモンの奥地にて彼女たちから想いを返された紫乃は^00記憶に触れ、自分を好きでいられる世界で生きたい^00という自身の本当の願いを受け入れる。新世界創造を^00取り止めた後、月ノ宮女子に転校した彼女は、^00陽桜莉たちと新たな生活を送り始めた。
records.en_original: Reconciliation with Hiori, and Her True Wish^00The feelings Shino had let go of were retrieved by Hiori and the others. She was given back those feelings deep within the Common, remembering her old self and accepting her true wish—to live in a world where she can love herself. After deciding not to create a new world, she transfers to Tsukinomiya Girls' Academy and begins a new life with Hiori and her friends.
records.en: Reconciliation with Hiori, and Her True Wish^00The feelings Shino had let go of were retrieved by Hiori and the others.^00She was given back those feelings deep within the Common,^00remembering her old self and accepting her true wish—to live^00in a world where she can love herself. After deciding not to create^00a new world, she transfers to Tsukinomiya Girls' Academy^00and begins a new life with Hiori and her friends.

records.jp: 〇月ノ宮の事件における夕月^00コモンと現実世界をつないでいる少女。司城来夢の姉。^00星ノ宮での事件が解決し時間が巻き戻った後の世界では、^00メッセンジャーとしての役割だけでなくコモンの管理も^00担っている。
records.en_original: Yuzuki During the Events at Tsukinomiya^00Yuzuki serves as the connection between the Common and the real world. She is the older sister of Lime Shijou. In the world after the events at Hoshinomiya are resolved and time is turned back, she not only fulfills her role as a messenger, but also takes on the responsibility of managing the Common.

In the world after the events at Hoshinomiya are resolved^00and time is turned back, she not only fulfills her role as a messenger,^00but also takes on the responsibility of managing the Common.

records.jp: 〇月ノ宮の事件における来夢^00コモンと現実世界をつないでいる少女。司城夕月の妹。^00星ノ宮での事件が解決し時間が巻き戻った後の世界では、^00メッセンジャーとしての役割だけでなくコモンの管理も^00担っている。

records.jp: 〇月ノ宮の事件における有理^00研究機関ＡＡＳＡに所属している少女。^00月ノ宮女子高等学校に潜入し、月ノ宮で起きている^00事件の調査を行っていた。都を通じ、コモンや敵対する^00リフレクターについての情報を陽桜莉らへ提供している。^00コモンの扉が開いた後も接触を続けており、都に想いを^00守るための指輪を渡した。
records.en_original: Yuri During the Events at Tsukinomiya^00Yuri belongs to research organization AASA. She infiltrated Tsukinomiya Girls' High School to investigate the incidents occurring in Tsukinomiya. Through Miyako, she provided information to Hiori and the others about the Common and hostile Reflectors. Even after the Common's door opened, she maintained contact and gave Miyako a ring to protect her feelings.
records.en: Yuri During the Events at Tsukinomiya^00Yuri belongs to research organization AASA.^00She infiltrated Tsukinomiya Girls' High School to investigate^00the incidents occurring in Tsukinomiya. Through Miyako, she provided^00information to Hiori and the others about the Common and hostile Reflectors.^00Even after the Common's door opened, she maintained contact and gave Miyako^00a ring to protect her feelings.

records.jp: 〇涼楓の人となり^00聖イネス学園での戦いの後、瑠夏が出会った少女。^00幼馴染みの亜未琉に対し、友情以上の特別な感情を^00抱いている。もっとも、その感情を自覚したのは最近の^00こと。亜未琉の抱える恋心に気づけず、彼女に想いを^00捨てさせてしまった過去を持つ。それを悔やんだ涼楓は、^00以来、彼女の想いを取り戻す方法を探し続けてきた。
records.en_original: About Ryoka^00A girl who Ruka met after the battle at St. Ines Academy. She holds feelings for her childhood friend Amiru that go beyond simple friendship, though she only recently became aware of those emotions herself. Ryoka failed to notice the romantic feelings Amiru harbored for her, leading Amiru to give up her feelings in the past. Regretting this deeply, Ryoka has since been searching for a way to bring back Amiru's emotions.
records.en: About Ryoka A girl who Ruka^00met after the battle at St. Ines Academy. She holds feelings^00for her childhood friend Amiru that go beyond simple friendship,^00though she only recently became aware of those emotions herself. Ryoka^00failed to notice the romantic feelings Amiru harbored for her,^00leading Amiru to give up her feelings in the past. Regretting this deeply,^00Ryoka has since been searching for a way to bring back Amiru's emotions.

records.jp: 〇ルージュリフレクター化の決断^00コモンの扉を開くことが、亜未琉の想いを取り戻す^00重要なステップである。美弦の言葉を信じた涼楓は、^00赤い指輪の力を駆使するリフレクターになった。^00コモンと現実世界をつなぐため陽桜莉のフラグメントが^00必要と語る涼楓は、亜未琉と共に彼女へ攻撃を仕掛けた。
records.en_original: Decision to become a Rouge Reflector^00Opening the door to the Common is an important step in regaining Amiru's feelings. Trusting Mio's words, Ryoka became a Reflector, wielding the power of the red ring. Believing that Hiori's Fragment is needed to connect the Common and the real world, Ryoka attacks her together with Amiru.
records.en: Decision to become a Rouge Reflector^00Opening the door to the Common is an important step^00in regaining Amiru's feelings. Trusting Mio's words, Ryoka^00became a Reflector, wielding the power of the red ring.^00Believing that Hiori's Fragment is needed to connect the Common^00and the real world, Ryoka attacks her together with Amiru.

records.jp: 〇陽桜莉たちとの和解と共闘^00涼楓は、陽桜莉らと敵対する決断が過ちであったと^00気が付いた。亜未琉と同じくフラグメントを失った百が^00想いを取り戻せたと知った涼楓は、今度こそ彼女を^00救うため、陽桜莉らと共にコモンへ乗り込み、紫乃の^00計画を止めるべく戦う。
records.en_original: Reconciliation with Hiori and Joining Forces^00Ryoka realized that her decision to oppose Hiori and the others was a mistake. Learning that Momo, who had lost her Fragment like Amiru, had been able to recover her emotions, Ryoka resolves to join Hiori and her friends as they enter the Common to stop Shino's plan, in order to save Amiru.
records.en: Reconciliation with Hiori and Joining^00Forces Ryoka realized that her decision to oppose Hiori^00and the others was a mistake. Learning that Momo, who had lost her Fragment^00like Amiru, had been able to recover her emotions, Ryoka resolves^00to join Hiori and her friends as they enter the Common to stop Shino's^00plan, in order to save Amiru.

records.jp: 〇亜未琉の人となり^00聖イネス学園での戦いの後、瑠夏が出会った少女。^00幼馴染みの涼楓に対し、友情以上の特別な感情を^00抱いてきた。しかし、涼楓が抱いている想いと自分の^00想いのズレに苦悩する。涼楓への特別な想いを手放すと^00決断した彼女は、仁菜に依頼し、フラグメントを抜いて^00もらったのだった。
records.en_original: About Amiru^00A girl whom Ruka met after the battle at St. Ines Academy. She has always held feelings for her childhood friend Ryoka that went beyond simple friendship. However, she struggles with the gap between her own feelings and those that Ryoka has for her. Deciding to let go of her special feelings for Ryoka, she asked Niina to remove her Fragment.
records.en: About Amiru A girl whom^00Ruka met after the battle at St. Ines Academy. She has always^00held feelings for her childhood friend Ryoka that went^00beyond simple friendship. However, she struggles with the gap^00between her own feelings and those that Ryoka has for her.^00Deciding to let go of her special feelings for Ryoka, she asked^00Niina to remove her Fragment.

records.jp: 〇ルージュリフレクター化の決断^00コモンの扉を開き、失った想いを取り戻す。^00そう覚悟を決めた彼女は、美弦の勧誘を受け入れ、^00涼楓と共に赤い指輪の力を駆使する^00リフレクターになった。^00目的を実現するためには陽桜莉のフラグメントが必要と^00訴える亜未琉は、涼楓と共に彼女へ攻撃を仕掛けた。
records.en_original: The Decision to Become a Rouge Reflector^00Amiru resolved to open the door to the Common and reclaim her lost emotions. With that firm determination, she accepted Mio's invitation and became a Reflector alongside Ryoka, wielding the power of the red ring. Amiru suspected that Hiori's Fragment would be necessary to achieve their goal, so she launched an attack against her together with Ryoka.
records.en: The Decision to Become a Rouge Reflector Amiru^00resolved to open the door to the Common and reclaim her^00lost emotions. With that firm determination, she accepted Mio's^00invitation and became a Reflector alongside Ryoka,^00wielding the power of the red ring.^00Amiru suspected that Hiori's Fragment would be necessary to achieve^00their goal, so she launched an attack against her together with Ryoka.

records.jp: 〇昏倒と目覚め^00フラグメントを失った状態でありながら、それでも^00リフレクターとして力を使った彼女は、陽桜莉たちとの^00戦いの末、ついに昏睡状態に陥ってしまった。^00コモンでの最終決戦が決着し、奪われたフラグメントが^00少女たちに還る中で、彼女は一人、^00病室で目を覚ますのだった。
records.en_original: Coma and Awakening^00Despite having lost her Fragment, Amiru continued to use her powers as a Reflector. After the battle with Hiori and the others, she ended up falling into a coma. When the final showdown in the Common came to an end and the stolen Fragments returned to the girls, she woke up alone in a hospital room.
records.en: Coma and Awakening^00Despite having lost her Fragment, Amiru continued to use^00her powers as a Reflector. After the battle with Hiori^00and the others, she ended up falling into a coma.^00When the final showdown in the Common came to an end and the stolen^00Fragments returned to the girls, she^00woke up alone in a hospital room.

records.jp: 〇月ノ宮の事件における由紀子^00体が弱く、人生の大半をベッドの上で過ごしてきた少女。^00普段はインターネットでの交流に没頭しており、^00「由紀姫」という名義で女子高生向けのお悩み相談を^00受け付けている。^00詩の策略によってフラグメントを奪われかけたが、^00それに気がついた都のサポートによって事なきを得る。
records.en_original: Yukiko During the Events at Tsukinomiya^00As her body was frail, Yukiko spent most of her life in bed. She usually would immerse herself in online interactions, offering advice to high school girls under the name "Princess Yuki." Although she almost had her Fragment stolen due to Uta's schemes, she managed to avoid disaster thanks to Miyako's timely support.

Although^00she almost had her Fragment stolen due to Uta's schemes,^00she managed to avoid disaster thanks to Miyako's timely support.

records.jp: 〇詩に襲われかけた後の由紀子^00事件の後も、由紀子と都は連絡を取り合っている。^00都経由で陽桜莉や瑠夏とも知り合うことになった。
records.en_original: Yukiko After Being Targeted by Uta^00Even after the incident, Yukiko and Miyako kept in touch. Through Miyako, Yukiko also got to know Hiori and Ruka.
records.en: Yukiko After Being Targeted by Uta^00Even after the incident, Yukiko and Miyako kept in touch.^00Through Miyako, Yukiko also got to know Hiori and Ruka.

records.jp: 〇佳奈の人となり^00仁菜と詩によってフラグメントを抜かれた少女。^00自らの辛い想いを失い、救われたと感じている。^00それ以降は悩みを抱える少女たちに詩を紹介し、無自覚^00ながら彼女らの計画を手助けしていた。しかし、想いを^00抜かれたことで徐々に衰弱し、昏睡状態となる。^00
records.en_original: About Kana^00A girl whose Fragment was removed by Niina and Uta. Having lost her painful memories, she felt as though she had been saved. Since then, she has introduced Uta to other troubled girls, and unknowingly helped with their plan. However, losing her emotions gradually weakened her, eventually leading to her falling into a coma.
records.en: About Kana A girl whose^00Fragment was removed by Niina and Uta. Having lost her painful^00memories, she felt as though she had been saved. Since^00then, she has introduced Uta to other troubled girls, and unknowingly^00helped with their plan. However, losing her emotions gradually^00weakened her, eventually leading to her falling into^00a coma.

records.jp: 〇由真の人となり^00月ノ宮女子高等学校の生徒。テニス部に所属している。^00テニスでは香織とペアを組んでおり、「えまゆま」ペア^00として有名。過去にいじめられた経験から、常に香織の^00考えに合わせてきた。そのことを彼女から指摘され動揺^00した結果、自身のフラグメントが暴走してしまう。
records.en_original: About Yuma^00A student at Tsukinomiya Girls' High School and a member of the tennis club. She pairs up with Kaori in tennis, and together they're well-known as the Ema Yuma pair. Having been bullied in the past, Yuma has always tried to go along with whatever Kaori thinks. When Kaori points this out to her, Yuma becomes upset, causing her Fragment to go rampant.
