Having been bullied in the past, Yuma has always^00tried to go along with whatever Kaori thinks. When Kaori points this out to her,^00Yuma becomes upset, causing her Fragment to go rampant.

records.jp: 〇香織の人となり^00月ノ宮女子高等学校の生徒。テニス部に所属している。^00テニスでは由真とペアを組んでおり、「えまゆま」ペア^00として有名。本来の実力は由真の方が上だと考えており、^00常に香織の腕や意見に合わせ続ける彼女に不満を抱いて^00いた。
records.en_original: About Kaori^00A student at Tsukinomiya Girls' High School and a member of the tennis club. She pairs up with Yuma in tennis, and together they are known as the Ema Yuma pair. Believing that Yuma is the more skilled player of the two of them, Kaori has grown dissatisfied with how Yuma always adjusts to her playing style and opinions.
records.en: About Kaori A student at Tsukinomiya Girls' High School^00and a member of the tennis club. She pairs up with Yuma^00in tennis, and together they are known as the Ema Yuma pair.^00Believing that Yuma is the more skilled player^00of the two of them, Kaori has grown dissatisfied with how^00Yuma always adjusts to her playing style and opinions.

records.jp: 〇朝子の人となり^00陽桜莉たちが生活する学生寮の寮長。^00周囲からは「鬼の寮長」と呼ばれている。^00容姿は彼女の母親とそっくりらしい。
records.en_original: About Asako^00The RA of the student dormitory where Hiori and her friends live. She's known as the Demon RA by those around her. It's said that she looks exactly like her mother.
records.en: About Asako The RA^00of the student dormitory where Hiori and her friends^00live. She's known as the Demon RA by those around her.^00It's said that she looks exactly like her mother.

records.jp: 〇加乃の過去^00紫乃の双子の姉。^00妹同様に母親からは金儲けの道具として扱われていた。^00日々母親の悪意に晒されてきた彼女は、最終的に妹の^00目の前で命を落とした。
records.en_original: Kano's Past^00Kano is Shino's older twin sister. Like her younger sister, she was treated as a tool for making money by their mother. Subjected to her mother's malice day after day, she ultimately lost her life right before her sister's eyes.
records.en: Kano's Past Kano is Shino's^00older twin sister. Like^00her younger sister, she was treated as a tool for making money by their mother.^00Subjected to her mother's malice day after day, she ultimately lost her^00life right before her sister's eyes.

records.jp: 〇リーダーの人となり^00日ノ杜学園の異灰討滅特殊部隊に転属してきた少年。^00転属前は日ノ杜学園広島校にて特殊部隊を率い、異灰の^00消滅を成功させた。輝かしい実績を持つエリートとして、^00司城あやかにより招聘される。新リーダーとして、最弱^00とも評される特殊部隊の立て直しを期待されている。
records.en_original: About the Leader^00A young man who has transferred to the Special Testa Elimination Unit at Hinomori Academy. Prior to the transfer, he led a special unit at the Hiroshima campus of Hinomori Academy and succeeded in eradicating the Testa there. As an elite with a distinguished track record, he was personally invited to his new position by Ayaka Shijou. As the new leader, he is expected to rebuild what is considered the academy's weakest special unit.
records.en: About the Leader A young man who has transferred to the Special Testa Elimination^00Unit at Hinomori Academy. Prior to the transfer, he led a special unit^00at the Hiroshima campus of Hinomori Academy and succeeded in eradicating^00the Testa there. As an elite with a distinguished track record, he was personally^00invited to his new position by Shijou Ayaka. As the new leader, he^00is expected to rebuild what is considered the academy's weakest special unit.

records.jp: 〇リーダーの能力^00リーダーの有する能力は「エーテルフェログラム」。^00自身の意識を別の対象の潜在意識の中に送り込む能力。^00対象のイローデッドとしての能力を強化できるほか、^00想いの暴走を制御することもできる。
records.en_original: The Leader's Ability^00The leader has an ability called "Ether Pherogram." This power allows him to send his consciousness into the subconscious of another. Not only does it enhance the target's abilities as an Eroded, but it can also help control rampant emotions.
records.en: The Leader's Ability The leader^00has an ability called "Ether Pherogram." This power^00allows him to send his consciousness into the subconscious of another.^00Not only does it enhance the target's abilities as an Eroded,^00but it can also help control rampant emotions.

records.jp: 〇能力の真の効用^00エーテルフェログラムの本来の能力は、イローデッドの^00潜在能力を引き出すことではなく、イローデッドと^00リフレクターの想いを一つに束ねることだった。束ねた^00想いを元として、一つの新しい世界を創る。それが^00リーダーに任された最後の役割だった。
records.en_original: The True Purpose of the Ability^00Ether Pherogram's primary function was not to draw out the latent abilities of the Eroded, but to unite the thoughts of the Eroded and the Reflectors as one. Using these unified thoughts as a foundation, a new world would be born. That was the final task entrusted to the leader.
records.en: The True Purpose of the Ability^00Ether Pherogram's primary function was not to draw out^00the latent abilities of the Eroded, but to unite^00the thoughts of the Eroded and the Reflectors as one. Using these unified^00thoughts as a foundation, a new world would be born.^00That was the final task entrusted to the leader.

records.jp: 〇詩帆の人となり^00灰病の治療のため、日ノ杜学園に転校してきた少女。^00周囲との和を大事にする優しい性格。^00実家が喫茶店だったため、コーヒーや紅茶にはこだわり^00がある。また、料理の腕前もかなりのもの。^00何も聞かされないまま、^00対異灰討滅特殊部隊に配属される。
records.en_original: About Shiho^00A girl who transferred to Hinomori Academy to receive treatment for Ash Syndrome. Shiho is kind-hearted and values harmony with those around her. Having grown up in a family-owned cafe, she has a discerning taste for coffee and tea. She is also quite skilled at cooking. Without any explanation, she is assigned to the Special Testa Elimination Unit.
records.en: About Shiho A girl^00who transferred to Hinomori Academy to receive treatment for Ash Syndrome.^00Shiho is kind-hearted and values harmony with those^00around her. Having grown up in a family-owned cafe, she has a discerning^00taste for coffee and tea. She is also quite skilled at cooking.^00Without any explanation, she^00is assigned to the Special Testa Elimination Unit.

records.jp: 〇詩帆の能力^00詩帆が有する能力は「セル・リコンストラクタ」。^00周囲の灰を消費して対象の細胞を活性化させ、治癒力を^00高める回復能力。細胞活性化段階でのコントロールに^00よっては、逆に相手の肉体を破壊することもできる。
records.en_original: Shiho's Ability^00Shihou's ability is called "Cell Reconstructor." By consuming surrounding Ash, she can activate the target's cells and enhance their natural healing power. With precise control during the cell activation stage, she can even reverse the process to destroy the opponent's body instead.
records.en: Shiho's Ability^00Shihou's ability is called "Cell Reconstructor." By consuming^00surrounding Ash, she can activate the target's cells and enhance their natural^00healing power. With precise control during the cell activation stage,^00she can even reverse the process to destroy the opponent's body instead.

records.jp: 〇イローデッドとしての覚醒^00異灰の存在はおろか、自分がイローデッドであることも^00知らないまま出撃した詩帆は、死と隣り合わせの戦場に^00怯え、戸惑う。しかし、自らを庇って負傷した由紀子を^00救えるだけの力を持っていることを知り、自分も戦うと^00決めた彼女は、ついにイローデッドとしての能力を開花^00させた。覚醒後は、アレシアの新バディを任されている。
records.en_original: Awakening as an Eroded^00Shiho was sent into battle while being unaware of the Testa's existence, or even the fact that she is an Eroded, frightened and confused by the ever-present threat of death on the battlefield. However, when she realized she had the power to save Yukiko, who was injured protecting her, she resolved to fight as well. In that moment, she finally awakened her abilities as an Eroded. After her awakening, Shiho is entrusted as Alesia's new partner.
records.en: Awakening as an Eroded Shiho was sent into battle while being unaware^00of the Testa's existence, or even the fact that she is an Eroded,^00frightened and confused by the ever-present threat of death^00on the battlefield. However, when she realized she had the power to save^00Yukiko, who was injured protecting her, she resolved to fight as well.^00In that moment, she finally awakened her abilities as an Eroded.^00After her awakening, Shiho is entrusted as Alesia's new partner.

records.jp: 〇バディとのすれ違いと和解^00バディ結成当初はアレシアとすれ違いを起こしてしまう。^00それは彼女の抱える深い悲しみが原因だった。彼女が^00命を懸けて自分を助けてくれた日、近しい人の死に^00怯えるその不安を受け止めた詩帆は、アレシアと和解。^00その時以来、彼女は詩帆にとって特別な人になった。
records.en_original: Conflict and Reconciliation with Her Partner^00There was a misunderstanding between Shiho and Alesia when they first became partners. The cause was the deep sorrow Alesia carried within her. On the day Alesia risked her life to save her, Shiho accepted the fear of losing someone close to her that haunted Alesia, and they reconciled. From that moment on, Alesia became someone truly special to Shiho.
records.en: Conflict and Reconciliation with Her Partner There was a misunderstanding^00between Shiho and Alesia when they first became partners.^00The cause was the deep sorrow Alesia carried within her. On the day^00Alesia risked her life to save her, Shiho accepted the fear of losing^00someone close to her that haunted Alesia, and they reconciled.^00From that moment on, Alesia became someone truly special to Shiho.

records.jp: 〇世界最後の日の想い^00世界最後の日、詩帆はアレシアに唇を奪われた。^00彼女のまっすぐな告白を受け止めた詩帆は、内心、^00自分もずっと一緒にいたいと願う。しかし、彼女ほどの^00大胆さと、自分の気持ちを表現する術は、まだ備えて^00いなかった。ゆえに詩帆は彼女との再会を第一の願いと^00した。次に会った時、自分から口づけするために。
records.en_original: Memories of the Final Day of the World^00On the last day of the world, Alesia stole a kiss from Shiho. Shiho accepted her heartfelt confession, and deep down, she longed to always be by her side as well. However, she lacked both Alesia's boldness and the ability to express her own feelings. So, Shiho's greatest wish became to see her again—so that next time, she could be the one to initiate a kiss.
records.en: Memories of the Final^00Day of the World On the last day of the world, Alesia stole a kiss^00from Shiho. Shiho accepted her heartfelt confession,^00and deep down, she longed to always be by her side as well. However,^00she lacked both Alesia's boldness and the ability to express^00her own feelings. So, Shiho's greatest wish became to see her^00again—so that next time, she could be the one to initiate a kiss.

records.jp: 〇アレシアの人となり^00日ノ杜学園の対異灰殲滅特殊部隊に所属する少女。^00感情変化が薄く、自らの生き死ににすら関心がない。^00学園に来るよりも前の経験から、「不平等」な理不尽を^00嫌悪している。逆に、全世界に「平等」な死をもたらす^00灰に憧れを抱いており、任務のたび収集している。^00新たに配属された詩帆のバディとなる。
records.en_original: About Alesia^00A girl belonging to the Special Testa Elimination Unit of Hinomori Academy. She shows few emotions and has no interest even in her own life or death. Due to experiences before coming to the academy, she has a deep hatred for inequality. Conversely, she admires the Ash, which brings "equal" death to the entire world, and collects it during missions. She is assigned as Shiho's partner after she joins the team.
records.en: About Alesia A girl^00belonging to the Special Testa Elimination Unit of Hinomori Academy.^00She shows few emotions and has no interest even in her own life or death.^00Due to experiences before coming to the academy, she has a deep hatred^00for inequality. Conversely, she admires the Ash, which brings "equal"^00death to the entire world, and collects it during missions.^00She is assigned as Shiho's partner after she joins the team.

records.jp: 〇アレシアの能力^00アレシアが有する能力は「エーテルスワップ」。^00対象の肉体的なダメージやエーテルの消耗などを^00別の対象と入れ替える能力。たとえば、味方の怪我を^00自分の体に移すことができる。
records.en_original: Alesia's Ability^00Alesia possesses the ability called "Ether Swap." This power allows her to exchange physical damage or Ether depletion between targets. For example, she can transfer an ally's injury onto herself.
records.en: Alesia's Ability Alesia possesses^00the ability called "Ether Swap." This^00power allows her to exchange physical damage or Ether^00depletion between targets. For example, she can transfer^00an ally's injury onto herself.

records.jp: 〇詩帆を通して見ていたもの^00新バディとして距離を縮めようとする詩帆に、^00アレシアはかつて相方だった亜美の姿を重ねる。^00その亜美と同じくクイーンに侵食され、詩帆は昏倒^00してしまう。もう大切な人を目の前で失いたくないと^00覚悟を固めた彼女は、自らの命を懸けて能力を発動し、^00詩帆の受けたすべてのダメージを肩代わりした。
records.en_original: What She Saw Through Shiho^00As she tries to grow closer to her new partner Shiho, Alesia sees the image of her former partner, Ami, in her. Just like Ami, Shiho is corroded by a Queen's influence and collapses. Determined not to lose another person she holds dear right before her eyes, Alesia resolves to risk her own life, activating her ability to take on all the damage Shiho had suffered.
records.en: What She Saw Through Shiho As she^00tries to grow closer to her new partner Shiho, Alesia^00sees the image of her former partner, Ami, in her. Just like^00Ami, Shiho is corroded by a Queen's influence and collapses.^00Determined not to lose another person she holds dear right^00before her eyes, Alesia resolves to risk her own life, activating^00her ability to take on all the damage Shiho had suffered.

records.jp: 〇詩帆への想い^00致命傷を引き受けて以降、アレシアは詩帆と睦まじく^00過ごしてきた。それでもふと、滅んだ故郷での生活や^00家族、友人のことを思い出すと、彼女は罪悪感を覚えて^00しまう。そんな彼女に、詩帆は、自分が幸せにして^00みせると約束する。真意はどうあれ、この言葉を聞いた^00とき、彼女にとって今のバディは特別な人になった。
records.en_original: Feelings for Shiho^00Ever since Alesia took a fatal blow for Shiho, the two have grown close. Even so, when Alesia occasionally remembers her life in her destroyed homeland—her family and friends—she can't help but feel guilty. In response, Shiho promises her that she will make her happy. Whatever Shiho's true intentions may have been, when Alesia heard these words, her current partner became someone truly special to her.
records.en: Feelings for Shiho^00Ever since Alesia took a fatal blow for Shiho, the two have grown close.^00Even so, when Alesia occasionally remembers her life in her^00destroyed homeland—her family and friends—she can't help but feel guilty.^00In response, Shiho promises her that she will make her happy.^00Whatever Shiho's true intentions may have been, when Alesia heard these^00words, her current partner became someone truly special to her.

records.jp: 〇世界最後の日の行動^00世界最後の日、アレシアは詩帆の唇を奪った。^00かつての自分なら、たとえどれだけ想っていたとしても^00口にしなかった言葉を、彼女にまっすぐ伝える。耳まで^00紅潮させながらうろたえる彼女を眺め、アレシアは、^00好きになった理由を一つずつ噛みしめていくのだった。
records.en_original: Actions on the Final Day of the World^00On the last day of the world, Alesia stole a kiss from Shiho. The person she used to be would never have spoken the words she was about to say, no matter how she felt. Yet now, she looked Shiho straight in the eye and told her everything. Watching as a flustered Shiho turned bright red, Alesia quietly savored each and every reason she had fallen in love with her.
records.en: Actions on the Final Day of the World On the last day of the world,^00Alesia stole a kiss from Shiho. The person she used to be would never^00have spoken the words she was about to say, no matter how she felt.^00Yet now, she looked Shiho straight in the eye and told her everything.^00Watching as a flustered Shiho turned bright red, Alesia quietly^00savored each and every reason she had fallen in love with her.

records.jp: 〇美岐の人となり^00日ノ杜学園の対異灰殲滅特殊部隊に所属する少女。^00対異灰戦闘の実戦経験が豊富で実力も高い。以前は^00部隊のリーダーを務めていた。^00正義感が強く仲間想いな性格をしているが、生真面目で^00口下手なため、周囲からは誤解されがち。^00由紀子のバディ。
records.en_original: About Meiqi^00A girl who belongs to the Special Testa Elimination Unit of Hinomori Academy. She has extensive real battle experience against Testa and possesses remarkable skills. She previously served as the squad leader. Though she has a strong sense of justice and cares deeply for her friends, her serious nature and lack of communication skills often cause misunderstandings with those around her. She is Yukiko's partner.
records.en: About Meiqi A girl who belongs to the Special Testa Elimination^00Unit of Hinomori Academy. She has extensive real battle^00experience against Testa and possesses remarkable skills.^00She previously served as the squad leader. Though she has a strong^00sense of justice and cares deeply for her friends, her serious^00nature and lack of communication skills often cause^00misunderstandings with those around her. She is Yukiko's partner.

records.jp: 〇美岐の能力^00美岐が有する能力は「ニューロン・パワード」。^00身体性能を一時的に跳ね上げる、いわばリミッター^00解除のような能力。菜々花の能力と似ているが、彼女の^00それが筋力のみの増強であるのに対して、イローデッド^00状態の美岐は、反応速度や俊敏性など、あらゆる身体^00能力が強化されている。
records.en_original: Meiqi's Ability^00Meiqi possesses the ability known as "Neuron Powered." This power temporarily boosts her physical capabilities, essentially allowing her to surpass her usual limits. While it is similar to Nanaka's ability, which enhances her strength, while in her Eroded state, Meiqi experiences an overall enhancement of all her physical abilities, including speed and reaction time.
records.en: Meiqi's Ability^00Meiqi possesses the ability known as "Neuron Powered." This power^00temporarily boosts her physical capabilities, essentially^00allowing her to surpass her usual limits. While it is similar to Nanaka's^00ability, which enhances her strength, while in her Eroded state, Meiqi^00experiences an overall enhancement of all her physical abilities,^00including speed and reaction time.

records.jp: 〇コンプレックスに寄り添ってくれた人^00着任当初は反発していたものの、共に成果を挙げる中で、^00美岐は、新リーダーの手腕を認め、信頼するようになる。^00だが一方、そのほかのメンバーも、以前ほど自分を^00頼らなくなった。劣等感に悩む彼女を立ち直らせたのは、^00かつての自分の言葉と、バディの存在だった。
records.en_original: Someone Who Accepted Her Insecurities^00Although she was initially resistant when the leader joined, as the team achieved results together, Meiqi came to acknowledge and trust the new leader's abilities. However, the other members also started to rely on her less than before. When she struggled with feelings of inferiority, it was her own words from the past and the presence of her partner that helped her regain her confidence.
records.en: Someone Who Accepted Her Insecurities Although she was initially resistant^00when the leader joined, as the team achieved results together,^00Meiqi came to acknowledge and trust the new leader's abilities. However,^00the other members also started to rely on her less than before.^00When she struggled with feelings of inferiority, it was her own words from the past^00and the presence of her partner that helped her regain her confidence.

records.jp: 〇隠すつもりも無くなった趣味^00実はかわいいものに目が無い美岐だったが、趣味を^00表に出す勇気が持てず、日々悶々と過ごしていた。^00そんな彼女も、仲間との交流を通し、少しずつ^00「自分の好きなものに誇りを持つ」大切さを知っていく。^00だから、今の彼女なら、^00ぬいぐるみが大好きだと、胸を張って言える。
records.en_original: A Hobby She No Longer Tries to Hide^00Meiqi has always had a soft spot for cute things, but she never had the courage to share her interests openly and spent her days feeling conflicted. However, through her interactions with her friends, she gradually learned the importance of being proud of what she loves. Now, she can boldly declare her love for stuffed animals without hesitation.

records.jp: 〇由紀子の人となり^00日ノ杜学園の対異灰殲滅特殊部隊に所属する少女。^00かなりの読書好きで勉強家。^00病弱だったため、他者と直接交流したことがほとんど^00無かった。イローデッド化し逆に体調が改善したこの^00数年、社交性を身につけようと努力している。^00美岐のバディ。
records.en_original: About Yukiko^00A girl who belongs to the Special Testa Elimination Unit at Hinomori Academy. She is an avid reader and a dedicated student. Due to poor health in the past, she rarely interacted with others, but after becoming Eroded and ironically regaining her health over the past few years, she has been making efforts to become more sociable. She is Meiqi's partner.

records.jp: 〇由紀子の能力^00由紀子が有する能力は「エーテル・シーカー」。^00生命や異灰のエーテルの流れを見る能力。^00異灰のコアの位置を把握することも可能であり、^00戦闘ではパーティーの「目」としての役割を果たす。
records.en_original: Yukiko's Ability^00Yukiko's ability is known as "Ether Seeker." She can perceive the flow of Ether within living things and Testa. This also enables her to sense the location of Testa Cores, making her the eyes of the party during battle.

records.jp: 〇詩への疑い^00まだ病弱だった頃、由紀子は詩によってフラグメントを^00抜かれかけたことがあった。それゆえ、彼女に対しては^00部隊の誰よりも深い猜疑心を抱いていた。^00抵抗する手立てを持たなかったあの頃とは違う、その^00証明も兼ね、邪悪な計画から仲間を守るため、由紀子は^00彼女と対峙する。
records.en_original: Doubt Toward Uta^00Back when her body was still frail, Yukiko once almost had her Fragment taken by Uta. Because of that, she harbored a deeper suspicion toward her than anyone else in the squad. Unlike back then, when she had no means to resist, Yukiko now stands against her to prove how far she's come and to protect her friends from her wicked schemes.

records.jp: 〇内弁慶……？^00ひょんな出来事から、由紀子のネット上でのペンネーム^00「由紀姫」と、彼女の執筆している際どい小説の存在が^00美岐の知るところとなってしまった。羞恥心から調子の^00上がらない彼女を助けたのは、陽桜莉の明るさと美岐の^00誠実さだった。人に甘える楽しさを知った彼女は、^00ほんの少しだけ、仲間を振り回すポジションに近づいた。
records.en_original: Actually Quite the Bold Person...?^00Due to an unexpected incident, Meiqi discovered Yukiko's online pen name, "Princess Yuki," as well as the risqué novels she writes. Embarrassed and unable to get back on track, Yukiko was helped by Hiori's cheerful support and Meiqi's sincerity. After learning the joy of relying on others, she found herself just a little bit closer to taking on the role of someone who keeps the group on their toes.

records.jp: 〇かんなの人となり^00日ノ杜学園の対異灰殲滅特殊部隊に所属する少女。^00いつも元気いっぱいで人懐っこい性格。^00体を動かすことが好きで、身体能力も抜群に高い。^00反面、勉強、あるいは頭を使うことが苦手。^00なぜかリーダーのことを「お兄ちゃん」と呼んでいる。^00彩未のバディ。
records.en_original: About Kanna^00A girl who belongs to the Hinomori Academy Special Testa Elimination Unit. She's always energetic and friendly. She loves being active, and her physical abilities are top-notch. On the other hand, she's not good at studying or anything that requires brainpower. For some reason, she calls the leader "big brother." She is Ayami's partner.

She loves being active,^00and her physical abilities are top-notch. On the other^00hand, she's not good at studying or anything that requires^00brainpower. For some reason, she calls the leader "Onii-chan." She^00is Ayami's partner.

records.jp: 〇かんなの能力^00かんなが有する能力は「エモーション・バズ」。^00彼女自身の感情に反応して、炎や雷が発現する能力。^00異灰に与えるダメージは絶大なのだが、感情の昂りを^00発動条件としているため、コントロールがかなり難しい。
records.en_original: Kanna's Ability^00Kanna possesses the ability known as "Emotion Buzz." This power creates flames and lightning in response to her own emotions. While it deals tremendous damage to Testa, it requires heightened emotions to activate, making it quite difficult to control.

records.jp: 〇かんなの素性^00「星谷かんな」という少女はこの時空の住人ではない。^00彼女は今の世界とは違う時空、彼女だけが生き長らえた^00世界から来た時間跳躍者である。元の世界の運命を変え、^00仲間を守る。その目的を叶えるためならなんでもする^00覚悟があった。結果的に今の世界が滅亡するとしても、^00彼女は止まらない——はずだった。
records.en_original: Kanna's True Identity^00Kanna Hoshiya doesn't come from this timeline. She is a time traveler from a world where she alone survived. Determined to change the fate of her original world and protect her friends, she was prepared to do whatever it took to achieve her goal. Even if it meant the destruction of the current world, she would not stop—or so she believed.

Even if it meant the destruction of the current world,^00she would not stop—or so she believed.

records.jp: 〇この世界で生きる覚悟^00素性を知ってなお変わらない、彩未や愛央、リーダーの^00想いは、かんなをこの世界に留まらせた。時間跳躍や^00世界の復元を諦めた彼女は、コズミックファングを解放^00すると、ひと時ばかり、バディの彩未と本音で語らう^00機会を得る。彩未の優しさをまたしても感じた彼女は、^00たそがれるのをやめ、今の世界で生きる決意を固くする。
records.en_original: Resolve to Live in This World^00Even after learning the truth about her, the feelings of Ayami, Ao, and the leader remained unchanged, convincing Kanna to stay in this world. Giving up on time leaping and restoring her original world, she released the Cosmic Fang and, for a brief moment, got the chance to speak honestly with her partner, Ayami. Feeling Ayami’s kindness once again, she decided to stop lingering in the past and firmly resolved to live in this world.

records.jp: 〇彩未の人となり^00日ノ杜学園の対異灰殲滅特殊部隊に所属する少女。^00「みんなのお姉さん」を自称しており、常にやわらかな^00雰囲気を纏っている。^00一歩引いた視点から周囲の状況を観察しており、^00任務では仲間を的確にサポートしてくれる。^00かんなのバディ。
records.en_original: About Ayami^00A girl belonging to the Special Testa Elimination Unit at Hinomori Academy. She calls herself "everyone's big sister" and always has a gentle air about her. She observes the surroundings from behind and provides precise support to her teammates during missions. She is Kanna's partner.
records.en: About Ayami A girl^00belonging to the Special Testa Elimination Unit at Hinomori^00Academy. She calls herself "everyone's older sister" and always^00has a gentle air about her.^00She observes the surroundings from behind and provides^00precise support to her teammates during missions.^00She is Kanna's partner.

records.jp: 〇彩未の能力^00彩未が有する能力は「イリュージョンクルー」。^00敵に幻覚を見せる能力。自分たちの姿を誤認させられる。^00あくまで幻覚を見せているだけであり、物音を立てると^00バレてしまうため、戦いの最中に使う場合は策が必要。
records.en_original: Ayami's Ability^00Ayami's ability is "Illusion Crew." She can show enemies illusions, causing them to misperceive what they see. However, since it's only a visual illusion, making any noise will give you away. Using this ability during battle requires a plan.
records.en: Ayami's Ability^00Ayami's ability is "Illusion Crew." She can show^00enemies illusions, causing them to misperceive what they see. However,^00since it's only a visual illusion, making any noise will give^00you away. Using this ability during battle requires a plan.

records.jp: 〇誰にも話さないこと^00部隊一味を襲ったエーテルの暴走による不調から彩未は^00無縁だった。それどころか、治療に必要な薬の保管先を、^00彼女はなぜか知っていた。何かを隠していることは^00もはや明らかだったが、彼女は決して口を割らない。^00仲間たちにも、彼女の事情を詮索しないだけの優しさが^00あった。
records.en_original: Something She Never Told Anyone^00Ayami was unaffected by the ailments that struck the squad when their Ether went rampant. In fact, she somehow knew exactly where the medicine needed for treatment was stored. It was clear she was hiding something, but she never uttered a word about it. Out of kindness, her companions respected her privacy and didn't pry into her circumstances.

Out of kindness, her companions respected^00her privacy and didn't pry into her circumstances.

records.jp: 〇かんなだけに話したこと^00彩未は蓬莱館製薬社長一家という一見恵まれた家庭に^00育った。だが、弟は父の実験材料として隔離中。彼女も、^00イローデッドの収集という父の密命を受け日ノ杜へ。^00「お姉さん」であることへの執着もまた父が絶対という^00歪な実家で育まれた。素性を隠してきたかんなに自分の^00境遇を重ねた彩未は、彼女に心を許し、再会を約束する。
records.en_original: Something She Only Told to Kanna^00Ayami grew up in what appeared to be a privileged family—the household of the president of Houraikan Pharmaceuticals. However, her younger brother was kept in quarantine and used for her father's experiments. Ayami herself was sent to Hinomori on orders from her father to collect Eroded. Her obsessive need to be "the older sister" also came from her upbringing in this twisted home where her father's will was absolute. Seeing her own circumstances reflected in Kanna, who also kept her background hidden, Ayami opened up to her and promised they would meet again.

records.jp: 〇菜々花の人となり^00日ノ杜学園の対異灰殲滅特殊部隊に所属する少女。^00気が強く、我も強い。特に男性に対しては尋常ならざる^00嫌悪感と敵意を抱いている。^00以前は異灰討滅任務にも積極的だったが、なぜか現在は^00出撃を拒否し続けている。^00きららのバディ。
records.en_original: About Nanaka^00A girl assigned to the Special Testa Elimination Unit at Hinomori Academy. She is strong-willed and very stubborn. She harbors an unusual degree of hostility and animosity, especially towards men. While she was once proactive in Testa extermination missions, for some reason she currently refuses to deploy. She is Kirara's partner.

records.jp: 〇菜々花の能力^00菜々花が有する能力は「セル・パワード」。^00一時的に自分自身の筋肉を成長させ、超人的なパワーを^00得ることができる。ただし、筋肉の急成長に体がついて^00いかないため、能力発動中は防御性能が落ちてしまう。
records.en_original: Nanaka's Ability^00Nanaka's ability is called "Cell Powered." She can temporarily increase her own muscle mass to gain superhuman strength. However, because her body can't keep up with the rapid muscle growth, her defense decreases while the ability is active.

records.jp: 〇元バディへの想い^00菜々花が任務への出撃を頑なに拒否し続けていたのは、^00クイーンに呑まれた樹里を殺したくないからだった。^00元バディを亡くし塞ぎ込む彼女を立ち上がらせたものは、^00リーダーづてで受け取った樹里の最後の言葉だった。^00彼女は、未練を断ち切り、前向きに生きていくことを^00樹里に誓う。
records.en_original: Feelings Toward Her Former Partner^00Nanaka stubbornly refused to go on missions because she did not want to kill Juri, who had been taken over by a Queen. When the leader delivered Juri's final words to her, it finally gave Nanaka the strength to stand up again. She swore to Juri that she would let go of her regrets and move forward with her life.

She^00swore to Juri that she would let go of her regrets and move forward^00with her life.

records.jp: 〇過去を振りほどく決意^00菜々花が男嫌いになった原因は彼女の家族にあった。^00彼女は自分の力で暴言と暴力の日々から脱出したが、^00それでも過去の記憶は消えない。そんな悩みをふと、^00彩未に零してしまう。相談を通じ、少しだけ気が楽に^00なった彼女は、過去を思い出しても気がつかないくらい^00強くなると決意する。
records.en_original: A Resolve to Break Free from the Past^00The reason Nanaka developed a dislike of men lies with her family. Although she managed to escape days filled with harsh words and violence through her own strength, her memories of the past wouldn't fade away. One day, she finds herself sharing these troubles with Ayami. Feeling a bit lighter after their talk, Nanaka is determined to become strong enough that memories of the past will no longer weigh her down.

records.jp: 〇きららの人となり^00日ノ杜学園の対異灰殲滅特殊部隊に所属する少女。^00どこか神秘的な雰囲気を纏っており、やや不思議な^00言動をすることもある。^00バディは菜々花なのだが、任務への出撃は二人一組で^00なければならないという規則の都合、彼女もまた、最近^00任務に出向けていない。
records.en_original: About Kirara^00A girl belonging to the Special Testa Elimination Unit at Hinomori Academy. She exudes a somewhat mysterious aura and sometimes behaves in strange or unusual ways. Nanaka is her partner, but due to the rule that missions must be undertaken in pairs, she too hasn't been able to go on any missions lately.

records.jp: 〇きららの能力^00きららが有する能力は「スプライトリープ」。^00残留思念が抱えるエーテルを再構築し、記憶や知識の^00形で自分のものにできる能力。雑念が見えたり、普通は^00聞こえない声が認識できたりするほか、遠くない未来を^00見通すこともできる。
records.en_original: Kirara's Ability^00Kirara possesses the power known as "Sprite Leap." This ability allows her to reconstruct the Ether held by lingering thoughts and make them her own in the form of memories and knowledge. She can perceive stray thoughts, recognize voices that are normally inaudible, and even catch glimpses of the near future.

She can perceive stray^00thoughts, recognize voices that are normally inaudible, and even catch^00glimpses of the near future.

records.jp: 〇菜々花への想い^00バディである菜々花は、過去への未練を断ち切り、前を^00向いた。自分よりもはるかに高い戦闘能力を持つ彼女に^00置いていかれてしまう不安と恐怖から、きららは、詩の^00甘言に乗り、クイーンの力に手を出してしまう。そんな^00きららを暗闇から救い出したのもまた、バディだった。
records.en_original: Feelings Toward Nanaka^00Nanaka, Kirara's partner, let go of her lingering attachments to the past and now looks forward. Kirara, anxious and afraid of being left behind by Nanaka, who possesses far superior battle abilities, gave in to Uta's sweet words and reached out for the Queen's power. It was Nanaka who saved Kirara from that darkness.

records.jp: 〇もう１つの能力の使い道^00きららには、イローデッドとしての能力とは別に、元々^00「神」の声を聞く力があった。彼女の実家や郷里は、^00その力を悪用した結果、世間からバッシングを受け崩壊。^00以来菜々花と出会うまで、彼女は卑屈に生きてきた。^00今は、その力を悪だくみに使う輩が周りにいない。成長^00した彼女は、改めて、皆の役に立ちたいと前を向く。
records.en_original: A Use for Her Other Ability^00Even before she gained her powers as an Eroded, Kirara possessed the ability to hear the voice of the Divine. Her family and hometown exploited this power, leading to harsh condemnation from society and ultimately their ruin. Until she met Nanaka, Kirara lived with a sense of inferiority. Now, with no one around to use her power for evil, she has grown stronger and faces forward, determined to use her abilities to help others.

records.en_original: About Ayaka^00A woman who commands the Special Testa Elimination Unit at Hinomori Academy. The squad members refer to her as "Commander." She always maintains a poker face and exudes a cool, composed presence. She has recruited a student as the new leader of the Special Testa Elimination Unit in order to rebuild it from the ground up.
records.en: About Ayaka A woman^00who commands the Special Testa Elimination Unit at Hinomori Academy.^00The squad members refer to her as "Commander."^00She always maintains a poker face and exudes a cool, composed^00presence. She has recruited^00a student as the new leader of the Special Testa Elimination^00Unit in order to rebuild it from the ground up.

records.jp: 〇あやかの本当の来歴^00特殊部隊の司令としての立場も、学校の一教師としての^00立場も、あやかにとっては仮初のもの。昔は研究機関^00ＡＡＳＡに所属し、兄の悠良と共に、従兄の司城教授を^00支援していた。夕月・来夢の死亡事故後、二人を復活^00させるため独自に活動を開始。蓬莱館製薬にて研究を^00続けてきた。世界滅亡間際、ついに姉妹と再会し涙ぐむ。
records.en_original: Ayaka's True Past^00Ayaka's roles as the commander of the special forces and as a school teacher are merely temporary facades. In the past, she belonged to the AASA research institute, where she supported her cousin, Professor Shijou, alongside her older brother, Yura. After the fatal accident involving Yuzuki and Lime, Ayaka began her own efforts to bring the two back to life in the real world. She continued her research at Houraikan Pharmaceuticals. On the brink of the world's end, she was finally reunited with the sisters and was moved to tears.

records.jp: 〇日ノ杜での事件における夕月^00妹の来夢と共に、コモンの番人をしている少女。^00灰に侵食され、消滅に向かう世界において、人類を存続^00させるため、リーダーや特殊部隊メンバーの想いを用い^00新たな世界を創り出そうと画策する。
records.en_original: Yuzuki During the Events at Hinomori^00Yuzuki serves as the guardian of the Common together with her younger sister, Lime. As the world is being consumed by Ash and is on the brink of annihilation, she plans to create a new world using the hopes of the leader and members of the special unit to ensure the survival of humanity.

records.en_original: Mysterious Girl^00A girl appeared before the leader who had been dispatched to the Izumo District. She disappeared after saying, "We've been waiting for you to arrive."

records.jp: 〇日ノ杜での事件における日菜子^00研究機関ＡＡＳＡに所属するリフレクター。^00調査任務のため日ノ杜を訪れるようになる。ＡＡＳＡの^00思惑とは別に、日ノ杜付近にあるコズミックファングを^00通じコモンへ到達し、そこで夕月・来夢を助けるという^00目的を、日菜子は持っている。^00詩帆は昔からの友達。彼女の淹れるコーヒーが好物。
records.en_original: Hinako During the Events at Hinomori^00Hinako is a Reflector affiliated with the research organization AASA. She comes to visit Hinomori on an investigative mission. Besides AASA’s intentions, Hinako has her own objective: to reach the Common through the nearby Cosmic Fang in Hinomori and save Yuzuki and Lime there. Shiho is an old friend of hers, and she loves the coffee Shiho brews.

records.jp: 〇今の世界に対する責任感^00世界の終末が近いと知ってなお、夕月や来夢が練った、^00リフレクターの想いをシェルター化するという策を拒絶^00する。これは、世界が滅ぶのは自分がダアトを倒した^00からであり、その責任は一人で取る、と考えていたため。^00最終的には周囲から説得され、雫世界構築に参加。終末^00間際、彼女は以前同様、夕月や来夢を忘れないと誓った。
records.en_original: Sense of Responsibility for the Current World^00Even after learning that the end of the world was near, she rejected the plan devised by Yuzuki and Lime to turn the Reflectors' feelings into a shelter. This was because she believed that the world was ending due to her having defeated Daath, and thus she alone should bear the responsibility. In the end, persuaded by those around her, she joined in the creation of the Oasis. As the end approached, she once again vowed never to forget Yuzuki and Lime.

records.jp: 〇日ノ杜での事件における愛央^00日ノ杜学園の姉妹校である広島校に通う少女。^00同校特殊部隊の新人。広島から転籍したリーダーの^00現部隊を見学しに日ノ杜を訪れる。^00明るい性格の持ち主で、ほぼ常時テンションが高い。^00長い間昏睡状態だったらしく、病院で目覚めるより前の^00記憶がない。それどころか身寄りも見つからないらしい。
records.en_original: Ao During the Events at Hinomori^00Ao attends a school in Hiroshima that is the sister school of Hinomori Academy, and is a rookie member of the school's special unit. She visits Hinomori to observe the current unit, led by the newly transferred leader from Hiroshima. Ao has a bright and cheerful personality, and her energy is almost always off the charts. She apparently spent a long time in a coma and has no memory of anything before waking up in the hospital, nor did searches turn up any of her relatives.

records.jp: 〇時を繰り返す存在^00偶然スマホを落とした瞬間に、^00愛央はそれまで失っていた記憶を取り戻した。^00何度も何度も世界の終末を経験してきた彼女は、^00自分と同じく、世界を周回しているかんなの計画を^00止めるため、彩未と共に駆け付けた。
records.en_original: A Person Who Repeats Time^00The moment she accidentally dropped her smartphone, Ao regained the memories she had lost. Having experienced the end of the world countless times, she rushed over with Ayami to stop Kanna, who had also come from a different timeline.

records.jp: 〇日ノ杜での事件における陽桜莉^00研究機関ＡＡＳＡに所属する少女。^00戦闘指導のため、日ノ杜を訪れるようになる。^00青い指輪の力で変身するリフレクターの一人で、^00由紀子とは共通の友人を持つ知り合い。^00理屈より感覚を重視する彼女の戦闘指導に、^00日ノ杜の特殊部隊一同はかなり苦戦した。
records.en_original: Hiori During the Events at Hinomori^00Hiori is affiliated with the research organization AASA. She visits Hinomori to provide battle training to the special unit. She is one of the Reflectors who transforms using the power of a blue ring, and is an acquaintance of Yukiko through a mutual friend. Her battle training, which emphasizes instinct over logic, proved to be quite a challenge for the entire Hinomori special unit.

records.jp: 〇コズミックファングでの詩との対峙^00コズミックファングでの戦いにおいては、^00研究機関ＡＡＳＡからの援軍として、戦車部隊と共に^00参戦。再び敵として詩とまみえる。真意を測るため、^00また、彼女を説得するため、陽桜莉は剣を向けたが、^00戦況を不利と見た詩は撤退してしまい、心が通じ合う^00ことはなかった。
records.en_original: Confrontation with Uta at the Cosmic Fang^00During the battle at the Cosmic Fang, Hiori joined the fight alongside the tank unit that was sent as reinforcements from AASA. There, she once again faced Uta as an enemy, raising her sword against her in an attempt to understand her true intentions and persuade her. However, seeing the battle turn against her, Uta retreated, and their hearts never truly connected.

records.jp: 〇日ノ杜での事件における詩^00詩帆や樹里の心の中で、リーダーが出会った少女。^00時折痛みを欲しがるぶりっ子キャラであることは^00間違いないのだが、急に冷静になる時もあるなど、^00いまいち掴みどころがない。^00詩帆たちの中に入り込んだ目的も方法も不明。そもそも^00敵か味方かもよくわからない。
records.en_original: Uta During the Events at Hinomori^00The leader encountered Uta inside Shiho and Juri's hearts. While she acts cute and sometimes shows masochistic tendencies, her sudden moments of calm detachment make her hard to pin down. Both her motives and means for infiltrating Shiho and the others are unknown. In fact, it's not even clear whether she's an ally or an enemy.

records.jp: 〇きな臭い代役^00チームからの脱退を申請したきららの代わりとして、^00特殊部隊に加入。本部から派遣されて来た人材として^00扱われている。一見すると人懐っこいが、^00裏では詩帆たちの人間関係を瓦解させるため暗躍。^00悪事が暴かれた後、リーダーの能力で精神を制御され、^00チームの監視下に置かれた。
records.en_original: Suspicious Stand-In^00Uta joined the special forces as a replacement for Kirara, who had applied to leave the team. She was treated as personnel dispatched from headquarters. While seemingly friendly at first glance, she secretly worked behind the scenes to undermine Shiho and the others' relationships. After her misdeeds were exposed, the leader used his ability to keep her under control, placing her under the team's watch.

records.jp: 〇詩の野望^00リーダーの制御から独力で抜け出した後、悠良の部下^00として、舞と共にコズミックファングへ侵入した詩^00だったが、彼の創ろうとしている世界が自分の理想とは^00真逆のものであると知り、失望する。謀反を起こした^00詩は、彼を消滅させ、自分の理想とする「互いに傷つけ^00合う世界」を創るため、詩帆たちと改めて敵対した。
records.en_original: Uta's Ambition^00After breaking free from the leader's control on her own, Uta infiltrated Cosmic Fang along with Mai as one of Yura's subordinates. However, upon realizing that the world he sought to create was the complete opposite of her own ideals, she was left disappointed. Uta rebelled, erased him, and once again became an enemy of Shiho and the group in order to create her own ideal world where people hurt each other.

records.jp: 〇亜美の過去^00アレシアの元バディ。^00任務の最中、体をクイーンに乗っ取られ、^00アレシアの手で討伐された。^00家族や故郷の友人だけでなく、異国の地で出会った^00大切な人すら失ったアレシアは、この一件以降^00死神を自称し始める。
records.en_original: Ami's Past^00Ami is Alesia's former partner. Her body was possessed by a Queen during a mission and she was defeated by Alesia's own hand. After losing not only her family and friends back home but also someone precious she met in a foreign land, Alesia began to call herself the Grim Reaper.

records.jp: 〇樹里の人となり^00菜々花の元バディ。^00任務の最中、体をクイーンに乗っ取られる。その後も^00かろうじて自我を保っていたが、リーダーと面会した^00時にはその精神力も限界を迎えており、彼に自分ごと^00クイーンを討伐するよう依頼した。敵として倒される^00その時まで、彼女は菜々花のことを想い続けていた。
records.en_original: About Juri^00Juri is Nanaka's former partner. Her body was taken over by a Queen during a mission. Even after that, she barely managed to maintain her sense of self, but by the time she met with the leader, her mental strength had reached its limit. She asked him to defeat both herself and the Queen together. She kept thinking about Nanaka until the very end.

records.jp: 〇舞の人となり^00詩帆たちの前に現れたリフレクターの少女。元々は詩の^00部下だったが、何者かの手によって洗脳されている。^00周囲の異灰を従属させ、自在に操る能力を持つ。
records.en_original: About Mai^00Mai is a Reflector who appeared before Shiho and her friends. She was originally Uta's subordinate, but she was brainwashed by someone. She has the ability to control and command surrounding Testa at will.
records.en: About Mai Mai is a Reflector^00who appeared before Shiho and her friends. She was originally^00Uta's subordinate, but she was brainwashed by someone. She^00has the ability to control and command surrounding Testa at will.

records.jp: 〇悠良の人となり^00秘密結社カタナ本部で灰の研究を行っている男性。^00あやかの兄であり、夕月、来夢とも血縁を持つ。^00ポーカーフェイスを崩さず、何を考えているのか^00分からない節がある。^00詩帆たちを襲った謎の不調の原因を究明し、彼女らを^00治療するため、本部から派遣されて来た。
records.en_original: About Yura^00Yura is a man who researches Ash at the headquarters of the secret organization Katana. He is Ayaka's older brother and is also related to Yuzuki and Lime. He rarely shows emotion, making it difficult to know what he's truly thinking. He was dispatched from headquarters to investigate and treat the mysterious ailments that befell Shiho and her friends.

He rarely shows emotion, making it difficult to know^00what he's truly thinking.^00He was dispatched from headquarters to investigate and treat^00the mysterious ailments that befell Shiho and her friends.

records.jp: 〇悠良の野望^00コズミックファングにて、悠良は自身の思惑を披露する。^00人間を創り出した原種とは全く異なる原種、ビナーの^00意思に賛同した彼は、「想い」という概念が存在しない^00世界を創造するため、詩と舞、二人のリフレクターを^00従え、密かに行動していたのだった。
records.en_original: Yura's Ambition^00Yura unveils his true intentions at the Cosmic Fang. Having aligned himself with the will of Binah, a different Sephira than the one that had created humanity, he had been secretly acting with the aid of the Reflectors Uta and Mai to create a world where the very concept of emotions does not exist.

records.jp: 〇詩の謀反^00悠良の最期はあっけないものだった。^00彼の目指す「想い」が存在しない世界には、痛みも^00苦しみも、それに伴う悦びも存在しない。そんな新しい^00世界のあり方を真っ向から否定した詩に裏切られ、^00彼は悪態をつきながら消滅した。
records.en_original: Uta's Rebellion^00Yura's end was abrupt. The world without emotions that he had wanted would have meant there would be no pain or suffering as well, which Uta refused to allow. She betrayed and annihilated him while berating him and his ideal world.
records.en: Uta's Rebellion^00Yura's end was abrupt. The world^00without emotions that he had wanted would have meant^00there would be no pain or suffering as well, which Uta^00refused to allow. She betrayed and annihilated him^00while berating him and his ideal world.

records.jp: 〇ビナーからの接触^00実際には、悠良はビナーに身体を乗っ取られており、^00本来の彼は１０年近く前に半ば死亡していた。^00研究機関ＡＡＳＡにて司城教授の研究成果や指輪の^00作成方法を盗み出しつつ、ＡＡＳＡ自体の分裂を^00主導し、神の武器を創設することで、悠良もとい^00ビナーは、原種どうしの争いに備えていたのだった。
records.en_original: Contact with Binah^00In reality, Yura's body had been possessed by Binah, and the real Yura had been half-dead for nearly ten years. While stealing Professor Shijou's research and the process of crafting rings at the research institute AASA, Binah—using Yura—also caused a division within AASA, creating the Divine Weapons, all in preparation for the coming conflict between the Sephira.

records.jp: 〇愛央の人となり^00ごく平凡な少女。補習を受けるために夏休み中の学校へ^00行ったはずが、気がつくと見知らぬ世界へと^00迷い込んでいた。現実とは思えない事態に戸惑いを^00覚えつつも、憧れていたファンタジーのような境遇を^00楽しんでいる。
records.en_original: About Ao^00A very ordinary girl. She was supposed to go to school during summer break for extra classes, but before she knew it, she had wandered into an unfamiliar world. Although she's bewildered by this unreal situation, she finds herself enjoying the kind of fantasy-like adventure that she's always dreamed of.

Although she's bewildered by this unreal situation,^00she finds herself enjoying the kind of fantasy-like adventure that she's^00always dreamed of.

records.jp: 〇特別な何かになるための道筋^00雫世界の中で少女たちのリーダーとして活躍すること。^00それが自分の憧れていた“特別”へと至る道だと考えた^00愛央は少女たちのまとめ役として奮闘していた。この^00世界で出会った少女たちとのつながりがいつの間にか^00“特別”なものになっていたと気付いた彼女は、その^00つながりを守るため、改めてリーダーとして立ち上がる。
records.en_original: The Path to Becoming Something Specia^00Ao took on the role of the leader of the girls within the Oasis, which she thought as her opportunity to become someone special as she had always dreamed of doing. She strove tirelessly to bring the girls together. Before she knew it, the bonds she formed with the girls she met in this world had become truly special to her. Realizing this, she resolved once more to rise as their leader, determined to protect those precious connections.

records.jp: 〇特別な何かを守る覚悟^00特別な何かを持つ何者かになりたかった愛央は、^00様々な特別と出会い、手にしてきた。^00その中で彼女は気が付く。自分が^00本当に求めるものは、“特別”のさらに先にあるのだと。^00だから彼女は、みんなを助け幸せにするために、この^00作戦を実行することにした。
records.en_original: Determination to Protect Something Special^00Ao, who once longed to become someone who possessed something special, has encountered many extraordinary things and gained countless unique experiences. Along the way, she realized that what she truly seeks lies beyond something just being "special." That's why she decided to carry out this plan—to help everyone and bring them happiness.
records.en: Determination to Protect Something^00Special Ao, who once longed to become someone who possessed^00something special, has encountered many extraordinary^00things and gained countless unique experiences.^00Along the way, she realized that what she truly seeks lies beyond something^00just being "special." That's why she decided to carry out this plan—to help^00everyone and bring them happiness.

records.jp: 〇繰り返される冒険^00愛央は、正確な時期がもう把握できない昔、世界^00システムに初めて触れた時以来、それと同一化して^00しまっている。責任感の強い彼女は、あらゆる時空に^00おいて雫世界が創られるたび、ココロトープでの冒険の^00ような出来事を繰り返し、引き続く世界へと少女たちを^00送り出している。
records.en_original: The Cycle of Adventure^00Ao has been integrated with the world system ever since she first encountered it, so long ago that she can no longer remember when exactly that was. With her strong sense of responsibility, she relives adventures like those in the Heartscapes every time an Oasis is created across all timelines and dimensions, repeatedly sending the girls off into each new world.
records.en: The Cycle of Adventure Ao^00has been integrated with the world system ever since she first^00encountered it, so long ago that she can no longer remember^00when exactly that was. With her strong sense of responsibility, she relives^00adventures like those in the Heartscapes every time an Oasis is created^00across all timelines and dimensions, repeatedly sending the girls off into^00each new world.

records.jp: 〇こころの人となり^00愛央がこの世界にやってきて初めて出会った少女。^00水に囲まれた学校で、伶那と勇希と３人で生活していた。^00この世界で目覚める前の記憶を失っているらしい。^00おっとりとした性格だが、意外としっかり者。理由は^00わからないが、「秘密基地」という言葉に^00引っかかりを覚えている。
records.en_original: About Kokoro^00Kokoro was the first girl Ao met after arriving in this world. She lived with Rena and Yuki at a school surrounded by water. It seems she has lost her memories from before she woke up in this world. She has a gentle personality, but is surprisingly dependable. For some reason, the words "secret hideout" seem to resonate with her, though she isn't sure why.
records.en: About Kokoro Kokoro was the first^00girl Ao met after arriving in this world. She lived^00with Rena and Yuki at a school surrounded by water. It seems she has lost^00her memories from before she woke up in this world. She has a gentle^00personality, but is surprisingly dependable. For some reason,^00the words "secret hideout" seem to resonate with her,^00though she isn't sure why.

records.jp: 〇こころと詩帆の過去^00幼少期は内気な性格で、いじめを受けることも多かった。^00そんなこころにとって、幼馴染の詩帆の存在は強い心の^00支えだった。秘密基地が好きだったのは、そんな詩帆と^00二人で作った思い出があったから。その出会いが^00彼女を大きく変え、やがて人類を守るリフレクターを^00目指すきっかけとなった。
records.en_original: Kokoro and Shiho's Past^00As a child, Kokoro was shy and often bullied. Her childhood friend Shiho was a strong pillar of support for her. Her love for their secret hideout came from the memories she made there with Shiho. That encounter changed her profoundly and eventually inspired her to become a Reflector to protect humanity.
records.en: Kokoro and Shiho's Past^00As a child, Kokoro was shy and often bullied. Her childhood^00friend Shiho was a strong pillar of support for her. Her^00love for their secret hideout came from the memories she^00made there with Shiho. That encounter changed her^00profoundly and eventually inspired her to become^00a Reflector to protect humanity.

records.jp: 〇理想はみんな仲良し^00どんな相手でも、歩み寄って、仲良くできるのが一番。^00こころはいじめっ子たちと和解した記憶を思い出し、^00今の自分を形作る大切な想いを取り戻した。その想いが^00あるからこそ、雫世界に来たばかりの愛央の手を^00引くことができて、今の二人がある。
records.en_original: Ideally, Everyone Gets Along^00No matter who it is, it's best to reach out and get along with others. Kokoro recalled the memory of reconciling with her bullies and regained the precious feelings that shaped who she is today. Thanks to those feelings, she was able to take Ao's hand when she first arrived in the Oasis, and that's why the two of them are who they are now.
records.en: Ideally, Everyone Gets Along^00No matter who it is, it's best to reach out and get along with others. Kokoro^00recalled the memory of reconciling with her bullies and regained^00the precious feelings that shaped who she is today. Thanks to those feelings,^00she was able to take Ao's hand when she first arrived in the Oasis,^00and that's why the two of them are who they are now.

records.jp: 〇勇希の人となり^00愛央がこの世界に来る前に暮らしていた少女のうちの^00一人。この世界で目覚める前の記憶を失っているらしい。^00常に元気いっぱいで、考えるよりも先に行動を起こす^00タイプ。他の仲間たちと違い、自分だけリフレクターに^00変身できないことに不満を覚えている。
records.en_original: About Yuki^00Yuki is one of the girls who lived in the Oasis before Ao arrived. She seems to have lost her memories from before she woke up in this world. Always full of energy, she acts before she thinks. She's frustrated that she's the only one who can't transform into a Reflector.
records.en: About Yuki Yuki is one^00of the girls who lived in the Oasis before Ao arrived.^00She seems to have lost her memories from before she^00woke up in this world. Always full of energy, she acts^00before she thinks. She's frustrated that she's the only one^00who can't transform into a Reflector.

records.jp: 〇勇希の真実^00勇希は灰病により既に亡くなっていた。世界システムは^00その魂を復活させ探知機として雫世界に送り込んでいた^00のだった。罪悪感からわざと嫌われようとする勇希^00だが、愛央たちはそんな彼女を受け入れた。みんなの^00優しさに救われ、伶那と本心からぶつかり合うことが^00できた彼女は、そのとき真の意味での仲間となった。
records.en_original: The Truth About Yuki^00Yuki had actually died from Ash Syndrome. The World System revived her soul and sent her to the Oasis so that it could be located. Out of guilt, Yuki tried to make herself disliked on purpose, but Ao and the others accepted her anyway. Saved by everyone's kindness and able to confront her true feelings with Rena, Yuki finally became a true member of the group.
records.en: The Truth About^00Yuki Yuki had actually died from Ash Syndrome. The World System^00revived her soul and sent her to the Oasis so that it^00could be located. Out of guilt, Yuki tried to make herself disliked^00on purpose, but Ao and the others accepted her anyway. Saved^00by everyone's kindness and able to confront her true feelings^00with Rena, Yuki finally became a true member of the group.

records.jp: 〇生への限りない執着^00一度死んだ自分が、元の世界で再び生を受けることを^00どこかで諦めていた勇希だったが、ココロトープに^00刻まれた雫世界での新たな思い出が勇希の心を動かし、^00生への渇望を見出す。病気でできなかった色んな^00ことを、新しい世界ですべてやりつくすのだと。
records.en_original: An Unyielding Attachment to Life^00Though Yuki had once given up hope of being reborn in the real world since she had already died, new memories forged in Oasis—etched into the Heartscape—begin to stir her heart. She discovers a renewed longing for life, determined to experience everything she couldn't because of her illness and to live to the fullest in the new world.
records.en: An Unyielding Attachment to Life^00Though Yuki had once given up hope of being reborn in the real world^00since she had already died, new memories forged in Oasis—etched into^00the Heartscape—begin to stir her heart. She discovers a renewed longing^00for life, determined to experience everything she couldn't^00because of her illness and to live to the fullest in the new world.

records.jp: 〇伶那の人となり^00愛央がこの世界に来る前に暮らしていた少女のうちの^00一人。この世界で目覚める前の記憶を失っているらしい。^00物事をはっきりと言う性格で、はしゃぐことの多い^00愛央や勇希をよくたしなめている。
records.en_original: About Rena^00Rena is one of the girls who lived in the Oasis before Ao arrived. She seems to have lost her memories from before she woke up in this world. Rena is straightforward and outspoken, often keeping the more lively Ao and Yuki in check.
records.en: About Rena Rena is one^00of the girls who lived in the Oasis before Ao arrived. She^00seems to have lost her memories from before she woke up in this world.^00Rena is straightforward and outspoken, often keeping^00the more lively Ao and Yuki in check.

records.jp: 〇伶那と勇希の過去^00伶那は真面目で、そして不器用だった。勇希は、彼女^00とはタイプのまったく違う、素直で快活な少女だった。^00共に過ごすうち、彼女は自分にないものを持つ勇希に心^00惹かれていくが、灰病が二人の間を分かつ。彼女は、^00勇希の行方を捜し灰の研究機関ＡＡＳＡへとたどり着く。^00彼女はそこで適性を見いだされ、リフレクターとなった。
records.en_original: Rena and Yuki's Past^00Rena was serious and awkward. Yuki, on the other hand, was an honest and cheerful girl—the complete opposite of Rena. As they spent time together, Rena found herself drawn to Yuki, who possessed qualities she herself lacked. However, Ash Syndrome drove them apart. While searching for Yuki, Rena ended up at the Ash research institute, AASA. There, her aptitude was recognized, and she became a Reflector.
records.en: Rena and Yuki's Past Rena^00was serious and awkward. Yuki, on the other hand, was an honest^00and cheerful girl—the complete opposite of Rena. As they spent time^00together, Rena found herself drawn to Yuki, who possessed qualities^00she herself lacked. However, Ash Syndrome drove them apart.^00While searching for Yuki, Rena ended up at the Ash research institute,^00AASA. There, her aptitude was recognized, and she became a Reflector.

records.jp: 〇勇希との雪解け^00勇希が記憶を取り戻したことで、伶那と彼女はようやく^00お互いの本当の気持ちを伝えることができた。彼女が^00すでに亡くなっていることも知ってしまった伶那は、^00彼女を必ず助けると誓う。
records.en_original: Thawing the Ice with Yuki^00With Yuki regaining her memories, she and Rena were finally able to express their true feelings to each other. Upon learning that Yuki had already passed away, Reina swore to save her, no matter what.
records.en: Thawing the Ice with Yuki^00With Yuki regaining her memories, she and Rena were finally^00able to express their true feelings to each other.^00Upon learning that Yuki had already passed away, Reina^00swore to save her, no matter what.

records.jp: 〇優しさと強さ^00ネガティブな伶那はあまり人を信じることが^00できなかった。しかし、愛央やみんなと過ごしてきた^00時間がその心を変え、彼女は過去にも色んな人が^00自分に手を差し伸べていたことに気がつく。世界の^00人々は、自分が思っているより強くて優しい。それを^00知った彼女なら、どんな困難にも立ち向かえるだろう。
records.en_original: Kindness and Strength^00Rena, who had a negative outlook on the world, found it hard to trust others. However, the time she spent with Ao and the others gradually changed her heart, helping her realize that many people in her past had also reached out to her. People are stronger and kinder than she ever imagined. Now that she understands this, she'll be able to face any hardship that lies ahead.
records.en: Kindness and Strength^00Rena, who had a negative outlook on the world, found^00it hard to trust others. However, the time she spent with Ao^00and the others gradually changed her heart, helping her^00realize that many people in her past had also reached out to her. People^00are stronger and kinder than she ever imagined. Now that she^00understands this, she'll be able to face any hardship that lies ahead.

records.jp: 〇学校にやって来た詩帆^00愛央たちが作った海の家の中から現れた少女。^00記憶を失っており、幼馴染だったこころのことは^00覚えていない。礼儀正しく、いつも丁寧な口調で話す。^00理由は忘れてしまったが、コーヒーを好きだったこと^00だけは覚えている。
records.en_original: Shiho Arrives at the School^00Shiho appeared from the beachside cafe that Ao and her friends built. She had lost her memories and couldn't remember that Kokoro was her childhood friend. Shiho is polite and always speaks in a courteous manner. Although she's forgotten the reason, she still remembers that she likes coffee.
records.en: Shiho Arrives at the School Shiho^00appeared from the beach hut that Ao and her friends built.^00She had lost her memories and couldn't remember that Kokoro^00was her childhood friend. Shiho is polite and always speaks in a courteous^00manner. Although she's forgotten the reason, she still^00remembers that she likes coffee.

records.jp: 〇詩帆の実家^00詩帆の実家は喫茶店。小学校にて問題を起こしたことが^00原因で転居しており、その罪悪感から新たな家業を^00よく手伝っていた。そんなある日、喫茶店へ客として^00訪れた日菜子と出会う。彼女と話し、その前向きな^00考え方に感化された詩帆は、自分の抱える問題と^00向き合うようになった。
records.en_original: Shiho's Family Home^00Shiho's family runs a cafe. Shiho's family moved after she caused trouble at her elementary school, and Shiho often helped out with the new business out of guilt. One day, she met Hinako, who had visited the cafe as a customer. After talking with her and being inspired by her positive outlook, Shiho found the courage to face her own problems.
records.en: Shiho's Family^00Home Shiho's family runs a cafe. Shiho's family moved after she caused^00trouble at her elementary school, and Shiho often helped out^00with the new business out of guilt. One day, she met Hinako,^00who had visited the cafe as a customer. After talking with her^00and being inspired by her positive outlook, Shiho found^00the courage to face her own problems.

records.jp: 〇選びたい道を行く^00詩帆は自分のせいで両親に望まぬ道を強いたのでは^00ないかと気にしていたが、それに対し両親は喫茶店を^00開くのも一つの夢であったと答えていたことを思い出す。^00人生のレールはどれが正解かなんてわからない。そう^00気がついた彼女は、自らの進むレールの先に^00素敵な景色があると信じ、^00ひたすら進み続けることを決意する。
records.en_original: Walking the Path She Chooses^00Shiho once worried that she had forced her parents onto a path they never wanted for themselves. But then she remembered that her parents had told her opening a cafe had always been one of their dreams, too. In life, there's no telling which track is the "right" one. Realizing this, Shiho chooses to believe that something great awaits at the end of the path she's chosen, and resolves to keep moving forward with confidence.
records.en: Walking the Path She Chooses^00Shiho once worried that she had forced her parents onto a path they^00never wanted for themselves. But then she remembered that her parents^00had told her opening a cafe had always been one of their dreams, too. In life,^00there's no telling which track is the "right" one. records.jp: 〇学校にやって来た日菜子^00愛央たちが作ったカフェスペースの中から現れた少女。^00記憶を失っており、昔会ったことのある詩帆のことは^00覚えていない。落ち着いた性格で、どこか達観した^00ような雰囲気を纏っている。バレエをやっていた過去は^00忘れてしまったが、バレエと聞くと心のどこかが^00ざわつくような感覚になる。
records.en_original: Hinako Arrives at the School^00Hinako appeared at the cafe space created by Aoi and her friends. She's lost her memories and doesn't remember Shiho, who she met in the past. She has a calm demeanor and carries an air of quiet detachment. Though she's forgotten her days as a ballerina, hearing the word "ballet" stirs something deep within her.
records.en: Hinako Arrives at the School^00Hinako appeared at the cafe space created by Aoi and her friends.^00She's lost her memories and doesn't remember Shiho,^00who she met in the past. She has a calm demeanor^00and carries an air of quiet detachment. Though she's forgotten^00her days as a ballerina, hearing the word "ballet"^00stirs something deep within her.

records.jp: 〇日菜子の過去^00かつて日菜子は将来を嘱望された天才バレエダンサー^00だった。しかし練習中の怪我が原因で、膝に重い^00後遺症を負ってしまう。生きがいだったバレエを^00踊れなくなり、失意のどん底にいた彼女を^00救い出したのは、夕月と来夢だった。^00すべてを思い出した彼女は、二人と再会することを^00決意する。
records.en_original: Hinako's Past^00Hinako was once a prodigious ballerina with a promising future. However, a training injury left her with a severe knee injury and lasting aftereffects. Unable to dance ballet that had given her life purpose, she fell into deep despair. It was Yuzuki and Lime who saved her from that darkness. Now, having regained all her memories, she resolves to reunite with them both.
records.en: Hinako's Past Hinako^00was once a prodigious ballerina with a promising future. However,^00a training injury left her with a severe knee injury^00and lasting aftereffects. Unable to dance ballet that had given her^00life purpose, she fell into deep despair. It was Yuzuki^00and Lime who saved her from that darkness.^00Now, having regained all her memories, she resolves to reunite^00with them both.

records.jp: 〇夕月・来夢との再会^00日菜子は夕月と来夢との再会を果たし、想いを吐露する。^00二人がいなくなって寂しかったこと、世界をおかしく^00してしまったのは自分なのではないかという罪悪感。^00二人の温かい言葉に、彼女は救われていった。再び^00離れ離れになるまでのわずかな時間を、彼女たちは^00噛みしめるように生きる。
records.en_original: Reunion with Yuzuki and Lime^00Hinako is finally reunited with Yuzuki and Lime and pours her heart out to them. She confesses how lonely she was without them and the guilt she feels, wondering if she was the one who made the world go wrong. Their warm words bring her comfort and relief. Cherishing the brief moments they have together before they're separated once more, the three of them try to make every second count.
records.en: Reunion with Yuzuki and Lime^00Hinako is finally reunited with Yuzuki and Lime and pours her heart out to them.^00She confesses how lonely she was without them and the guilt she feels,^00wondering if she was the one who made the world go wrong. Their warm^00words bring her comfort and relief. Cherishing the brief moments^00they have together before they're separated once more, the three of them^00try to make every second count.

records.jp: 〇本当の友達とは^00足の故障をきっかけに普通に生きることを始めた^00元天才の日菜子。愛央ともっと仲良くなるために、^00普通になろうと努力するが、取り戻した記憶から互いに^00自然体でいられるのが本当の友達なのだと知る。
records.en_original: True Friendship^00Once a prodigy, Hinako began living an ordinary life after injuring her leg. Hoping to grow closer to Ao, she tries hard to become more "normal," but as they regain their memories, they realize that true friends are those who can simply be themselves with each other.
records.en: True Friendship Once a prodigy,^00Hinako began living an ordinary life after injuring^00her leg. Hoping to grow closer to Ao, she tries hard to become more^00"normal," but as they regain their memories, they realize that true^00friends are those who can simply be themselves with each other.

records.jp: 〇学校にやって来た陽桜莉^00活発で、誰とでも親しく接することができる少女。^00姉の美弦と共にこの世界にやってきた。何事もまずは^00行動するのが一番、という考え方で、様々なことに^00積極的に取り組む姿勢を見せる。こころとは元の世界で^00面識がある。
records.en_original: Hiori Arrives at the School^00Hiori is a lively girl who can easily get along with anyone. She came to this world together with her older sister, Mio. Believing that taking action comes first, she's always proactive and eager to try new things. She and Kokoro knew each other in the real world.
records.en: Hiori Arrives at the School^00Hiori is a lively girl who can easily get along with anyone.^00She came to this world together with her older sister, Mio.^00Believing that taking action comes first, she's always proactive^00and eager to try new things. She and Kokoro knew each other^00in the real world.

records.jp: 〇陽桜莉の家庭環境^00陽桜莉がまだ幼かったころ、団地で肩身の狭い思いを^00していた彼女の母親は、限界を迎え唐突に姿を消して^00しまった。陽桜莉は突然の出来事に動揺するも、以降は^00美弦と二人で身を寄せ合い、強く生きていく。そんな^00ある日、因縁深い詩が二人の前に現れる。彼女によって^00導かれた二人は数年ぶりに母との再会を果たす。長き^00すれ違いの果てに、二人は再び家族の絆を取り戻した。
records.en_original: Hiori's Family Circumstances^00When Hiori was still a child, her mother, feeling ashamed of her life in their apartment complex, suddenly reached her limit and disappeared without warning. The sisters who were left behind vowed to live strong lives. Then one day, Uta appeared before them. Guided by her, the sisters were finally reunited with their mother after several years. After a long period apart, they were able to restore their familial bonds once more.
records.en: Hiori's Family Circumstances^00When Hiori was still a child, her mother, feeling^00ashamed of her life in their apartment complex, suddenly reached^00her limit and disappeared without warning. The sisters who were left^00behind vowed to live strong lives. Then one day, Uta appeared^00before them. Guided by her, the sisters were finally reunited^00with their mother after several years. After a long period^00apart, they were able to restore their familial bonds once more.

records.jp: 〇今の詩への想い^00過去の因縁から詩のことを良く思っていない陽桜莉^00だったが、人の善意を信じ、それでも彼女に寄り添う^00態度を見せた。詩が今の詩でいられるのは、^00そういった彼女の姿勢に救われたからなのかもしれない。
records.en_original: Thoughts on Uta Now^00Although Hiori didn't think kindly of Uta due to their past history, she chose to trust in people's kindness and still reached out to support her. Perhaps it was Hiori's willingness to believe and stand by her that allowed Uta to become who she is today.
records.en: Thoughts on Uta Now^00Although Hiori didn't think kindly of Uta due to their past history,^00she chose to trust in people's kindness and still reached out^00to support her. Perhaps it was Hiori's willingness^00to believe and stand by her that allowed Uta to become who she is today.

records.jp: 〇明るさは正義^00物事の表面しか見ることができていないと悩んでいた^00陽桜莉だが、持ち前の底抜けな明るさが^00たくさんの人を救っていることを知り、^00信念を貫き自分らしくあることを誓う。
records.en_original: Brightness is Justice^00Although Hiori once worried that she wan't able to see things beyond the surface, she came to realize that her boundless cheerfulness had saved so many people. With renewed conviction, she vows to stay true to herself and her beliefs.
records.en: Brightness is Justice Although^00Hiori once worried that she wan't able to see things beyond^00the surface, she came to realize that her boundless^00cheerfulness had saved so many people. With renewed conviction,^00she vows to stay true to herself and her beliefs.

records.jp: 〇学校にやって来た美弦^00おしとやかで思慮深く、儚げな雰囲気をまとった少女。^00妹の陽桜莉と共にこの世界にやってきた。何かに^00取り組むときは頭の中でしっかりシミュレートする^00タイプだが、それゆえに一人で色々と抱え込んで^00しまう節がある。
records.en_original: Mio Arrives at the School^00Mio is a gentle, thoughtful girl with an air of fragility. She came to this world together with her younger sister, Hiori. Mio is the type of person who carefully simulates everything in her mind before taking on a problem, but because of this, she tends to shoulder a lot of things alone.
records.en: Mio Arrives at the School Mio^00is a gentle, thoughtful girl with an air of fragility. She came to this^00world together with her younger sister, Hiori. Mio is the type^00of person who carefully simulates everything in her mind before^00taking on a problem, but because of this, she tends to shoulder^00a lot of things alone.

records.jp: 〇すべては妹とその友達のため^00母が失踪し、姉妹は二人で暮らすこととなった。^00大切な陽桜莉を守るべく、美弦は強くなる必要があった。様々なことを経験した今の姉妹には固い絆が結ばれて^00いる。妹とは異なる経緯でリフレクターとなった彼女は、^00雫世界では戦えないようだ。代わりに彼女は、^00明晰な頭脳と家事の腕を用い妹たちの生活を支える。
records.en_original: Everything Is for Her Sister and Her Friends^00After their mother disappeared, Mio and Hirori began living together on their own. Mio knew she had to become stronger in order to protect her beloved Hiori. Having gone through so much together, the sisters now share an unbreakable bond. Because Mio became a Reflector through different means than Hiori, she is unable to fight in the Oasis. Instead, she supports her sister and friends' lives with her sharp intellect and exceptional domestic skills.

records.jp: 〇妹との支え合い^00過去の失敗から新たな一歩を踏み出すことを恐れていた^00美弦だったが、陽桜莉の協力のもと、抱えていた^00罪悪感を乗り越えることに成功する。世界が素敵な^00ものであふれていることを思い出した美弦は、また^00少しずつ前向きに生きていけるだろう。
records.en_original: Support Between Sisters^00Although Mio had been afraid to take a new step forward because of her past mistakes, she managed to overcome the guilt she had been carrying thanks to Hiori's support. Remembering that the world is full of wonderful things, Mio can now start living more positively, little by little.

records.jp: 〇学校にやって来たきらら^00どこか浮世離れした、つかみどころのない少女。^00常識知らずな一面があり、彼女独自の世界観を^00構築している。かつては「神の声が聞こえる」という^00特殊な力を持っていたが、この世界では聞こえない^00らしい。詩帆と同じチームで戦っていた過去を持つ。
records.en_original: Kirara Arrives at the School^00Kirara is a mysterious girl who seems somewhat detached from reality. She has her own unique worldview that sometimes lacks common sense. She once possessed the special ability to "hear the voice of the Divine," but apparently she can't hear it in this world. She fought on the same team as Shiho in the past.

records.jp: 〇人生で大切にすべきもの^00「神の声が聞こえる」力を持っていたきららは村総出で^00担ぎ上げられ、権力を求めた親にも利用されてしまう。^00ある日、彼女は友達のユカを陥れる偽の宣託を語るよう^00親から命じられる。彼女はそれを拒否し、地位や名誉と^00引き換えにただ一人の友を守った。本当に大切なものは^00何か、神の声が教えてくれなくても、彼女は知っている。
records.en_original: What Truly Matters in Life^00Blessed with the ability to "hear the voice of the Divine," Kirara was exalted by her entire village and exploited by her power-hungry parents. One day, they ordered her to deliver a false prophecy to frame her friend Yuka. Refusing their command, Kirara chose to protect her one and only friend, even at the cost of her status and honor. Even without the Divine's guidance, she already knew what was truly important.

records.jp: 〇何があっても自分は自分^00神の声が聞こえなくなったきららは、人との接し方に^00不安を抱えるだけでなく、それが聞こえない自分には^00価値がないのではないかとも思い詰めていた。そんな^00失われた自信を、ユカと友達になった時の記憶や今の^00彼女を必要とする愛央の想いが回復させた。彼女は、^00神の声が聞こえずともきららとして生きていくと決める。
records.en_original: No Matter What Happens, She Is Still Herself^00After Kirara lost the ability to hear the voice of the Divine, she not only began to worry about how to interact with others, but also became convinced that she might be worthless without that voice. However, Ao telling her that she's needed and her memories of becoming friends with Yuka helped restore her lost confidence. She has decided that even if she can no longer hear the voice of the Divine, it doesn't change who she is.

records.jp: 〇学校にやって来た詩^00多くのリフレクターと浅からぬ因縁を持つ少女。^00痛みを感じる、与えることに生を実感する歪んだ性質を^00持っていた……はずなのだが、記憶喪失にともなって^00その歪みが消え、物腰柔らかな少女となっている。^00しかし、本質的には変わらず「駒川詩」であり、^00時折人とは違う一面を覗かせることも。
records.en_original: Uta Komagawa Arrives at the School^00A girl with deep, tangled connections to many Reflectors. She once had a twisted nature—feeling alive only through pain, whether suffering it herself or inflicting it on others, or so it seemed. However, after losing her memories, this distortion vanished, and she now acts with gentle composure. Still, at her core, she remains Uta Komagawa, and at times, she reveals a side of herself that sets her apart from others.

records.jp: 〇かつての自分への恐れ^00ココロトープの探索中“かつての詩”と^00“雫世界での詩”の人格が衝突。精神の均衡を失って^00大規模クラックを引き起こす事態となってしまった。^00雫世界で少女たちの優しい想いに触れた彼女は、^00かつての自分へと戻ってしまうことを恐れ過去と^00向き合うことを避けている。
records.en_original: Fear of Her Former Self^00While exploring her Heartscape, the personalities of Uta from the past and Uta in the Oasis came into conflict, leading to her to losing her mental balance and causing a massive crack. After experiencing the gentle feelings of the girls in the Oasis, she became afraid of reverting to her former self and now avoids facing her past.

records.jp: 〇過去の自分との相克^00詩は、二度目のココロトープ探索で記憶を取り戻す。^00かつて彼女は神の力を用い世界を創り替えようとして^00いた。記憶を取り戻した際、今の詩が打ち勝ったのか、^00過去の詩に飲まれてしまったのか、あるいは両者が^00融合したのか、わからない。ただ、今ここにいる^00彼女は人々の想いを繋ごうとする優しい少女である。
records.en_original: Conflict with Her Past Self^00Uta regained her memories during the second exploration of her Heartscape. In the past, she tried to use the power of the gods to reshape the world. It's unclear whether the current Uta overcame her past self, was consumed by her, or if the two have fused together. However, the girl standing here now is a kind soul, striving to connect the feelings of others.

records.jp: 〇愛央への想い^00詩の心に刻まれていたひまわり畑の記憶。その記憶に^00対し抱く感情と、愛央と手をつないだ時に抱く感情が^00どこか似ていることに詩は気付く。その想いの正体を^00察し、詩は微笑んだ。
records.en_original: Feelings Toward Ao^00A memory of a sunflower field was etched in Uta's heart. Uta noticed that the feelings stirred by that memory were somehow similar to the emotions she felt when she held Ao's hand. Realizing what those feelings truly were, Uta smiled.
records.en: Feelings Toward Ao A memory^00of a sunflower field was etched in Uta's heart. Uta noticed^00that the feelings stirred by that memory were somehow similar to the emotions^00she felt when she held Ao's hand. Realizing what those feelings^00truly were, Uta smiled.

records.jp: 〇神出鬼没の少女^00愛央たちの生活する学校に現れたツインテールの少女。^00神出鬼没な存在で、話しかけても返答はなく、^00気が付いた時には姿が消えている。^00幽霊みたいな子というイメージから、少女たちが^00勝手にユーコちゃんと名付けた。
records.en_original: The Mysterious Girl Who Appears Out of Nowhere^00A pigtailed girl who suddenly showed up at the school where Ao and her friends live. She appears and disappears without warning, never responds even when spoken to, and is always gone before you notice. Ao and the others decided to start calling this ghost-like girl Yuko.

records.jp: 〇学校にやって来た夕月^00雫世界の創造主である来夢の姉。この場所が、何らかの^00理由で危機に瀕した世界から身を守るためのシェルター^00であることを明かす。本来の夕月は明るく活発な少女^00だったが、雫世界創造の代償として感情を失って^00しまったようだ。素性が知れるまでは愛央たちから^00ユーコちゃんと呼ばれていた。
records.en_original: Yuzuki Arrives at the School^00Yuzuki is the older sister of Lime, the creator of the Oasis. She reveals that this place serves as a shelter to protect people from worlds on the brink of disaster. Yuzuki was originally a cheerful and energetic girl, but it seems she lost her emotions as a cost for creating the Oasis. Until her true identity was revealed, Ao and the others called her Yuko.

records.jp: 〇雫世界の管理補助者としての夕月^00来夢と共に、コモンを管理していた少女。世界が崩壊^00した際、未来に希望をつなぐべく、リフレクターの力を^00借りて“雫世界”を形成した。来夢が目覚めたことで^00サポートに回していた感情機能が開放され、かつての^00明るい夕月へと戻る。大切な親友である日菜子と言葉を^00交わせたことは、彼女にとって大きな救いとなった。
records.en_original: Yuzuki as a Sub-Administrator of the Oasis^00Yuzuki oversaw the Common alongside Lime. When the world collapsed, she formed the Oasis by borrowing the power of the Reflectors, hoping to preserve hope for the future. After Lime awakened, the emotional energy Yuzuki had diverted was released, and she returned to her cheerful former self. Being able to speak with Hinako, her dearest friend, brought great comfort to her.

records.jp: 〇学校にやって来た来夢^00今もココロトープ内で眠り続ける夕月の妹。少女たちを^00外敵から守る雫世界を正確に維持・管理するため、^00すべての力を費やしている。想いが揺らいで雫世界の^00維持が不安定になると、それだけ来夢にも負担が^00かかってしまうが、物言わぬ彼女の状態は^00伺い知ることができない。
records.en_original: Lime Arrives at the School^00Lime is Yuzuki's younger sister who sleeps within the Heartscape. Lime devotes all her strength to precisely maintaining and managing the Oasis which protects the girls from outside threats. If emotions waver and maintaining the Oasis becomes unstable, it puts more strain on Lime as well. However, since she doesn't speak, it's impossible to know how she's really doing.

records.jp: 〇雫世界の管理者としての来夢^00リフレクターを一か所に集め、少女の数だけ散在^00していた雫世界を管理する負担の軽減に成功。さらに、^00クマのぬいぐるみを通し日菜子たちと想いを共鳴させる^00ことで、ついに来夢は目を覚ました。二度と会えないと^00思っていた大切な親友である日菜子がこの世界にいる。^00それだけで彼女は未来に希望を見出すことができる。
records.en_original: Lime as the Administrator of the Oasis^00With all the Reflectors gathered in one place, the burden that managing the Oasis placed on Lime was reduced. After her feelings resonated with Hinako and the others through the teddy bear, Lime finally awakened. The fact that Hinako—her precious best friend whom she thought she would never see again—is here in this world is enough to give her hope for the future.
